description:
The building we’re in, is constructed according the latest earthquake regulations in 2022, in a safe, and silent street, in central Caferağa.

5-10 minutes of walking distance to all attraction points.

The building foundation is installed on the rock bottom with deep concrete piles, the structional system also has been chosen, for the possible earthquake wave direction. In conclusion, our building is designed and constructed to withstand any earthquake might occur in İstanbul.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Alper's place for almost a week and it was fabulous!
The apartment looked exactly same as in the photos. We felt like we arrived home straight away. The kitchen was very well equipped and everywhere was so clean. Location is central, literally two steps away from Kadikoy's main Bahariye Street. There is a bakery and a pastry shop at the top of the street where we had our breakfasts each day.
I was worried as I did not know where to stay in Kadikoy when we would visit as my parents moved out of Istanbul recently, however now I know we have a home there again!
I highly recommend staying in Kadikoy as i think it is the best neighbourhood in Istanbul and surely Alper's apartment is the place to sleep in.

Alpers place was a comfortable stay, very clean and great location. The only thing I would recommend is a better mattress for the bed, it’s quite uncomfortable, other than that we loved his place. The location is in the heart of kadikoy with many restaurants, bars, cafes, shops, everything you need is a few minutes walk. The host was very responsive at all times. I would definitely stay here again.

My husband and I stayed a month at Alper’s place. I would absolutely recommend for short and long stays. It’s a perfect location near everything but on a quiet street, well equipped, modern renovations, very safe area and safe building, very clean and comfortable with thoughtful amenities. And the WiFi was strong. 10/10 I would absolutely stay again.

Great host, very responsive. Ideal location, quiet but round the corner from active areas and stores. Apartment definitely matched the photos and description. We prefer a medium mattress and fluffy pillows, this apartment definitely has a firm mattress and pillows. Overall we had a lovely stay. .

Alper is an impeccable host. Very organized , amazing communicator and wonderful welcomer.
The place is exactly what a vacation should feel like. Beautiful, clean, and in an amazing neighborhood.
Feels great knowing I now won’t have to think twice about my future stays in Istanbul.
Highly recommend!!!

description: Our bungalow house is in the heart of the forest, at the point where the residential area, which is 5 km from the center of Ağva, meets the forest. The property is easy to access. It offers you a comfortable accommodation in nature with the breeze of oak, chestnut and linden trees, the smell of the forest, the sounds of birds and a unique view. It is 90 km from the center of Istanbul and 25 km from Şile, where you can escape from the busy life of the city and reach a unique and relaxing environment.

reviews.text: Thank you Sema for hosting us, place is very peaceful and great located with awesome view, very close to Ağva center. We enjoyed our short weekend holiday a lot. All was clean and ready. Cabin is exactly like it is described on the platform. Communication with the host was quick and very smooth, Sema is a lovely host, very helpful. We would like to stay again. Thank you so much.

Evle ilgili her şey son derece memnun etti. Sema Hanım eve kendi yaşadığı evmiş gibi özenmiş, ev ve eşyalar tertemizdi ve bakımlıydı. Mutfakta kullanabileceğiniz neredeyse her şey var, mutfak gereçlerinin bu kadar eksiksiz ve temiz olduğunu bilseydik daha çok mutfak alışverişi yapardık. Jakuziden çok memnun kaldık, büyüklüğü iki kişi için idealdi. Konum olarak mekanın bulunduğu İsaköy dik ve dar sokakları olan bir yer fakat onun haricinde mekana ulaşımda bir sorun yaşamadık, park yerleri de mevcuttu. Manzara gayet güzeldi, havası da son derece temiz ve iç açıcıydı. Ev sahibi Sema Hanım ve eşi çok ilgililerdi, her konu için bizimle iletişime geçtiler, biz iletişime geçtiğimizde de hızlıca cevap aldık. Son derece memnun kaldık, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

Sema was a brilliant host, very proactive and responsive. Her tree house is a beautifully peaceful place, that was clean and exactly like the pictures.
The location is a little out of the way but that makes it feel quite remote. Would stay again.

Ev sahibi çok nezaketliydi bizimle çıkış yaptığımız ana kadar iletişim içindeydi .Ev temizdi mutfakda kullanılan malzemeler temizdi.Eve ve ev sahibine diyecek söz yok ama konum ve ortam imkanı olarak fiyat fazla olmuş .

Evin konumu çok güzeldi 4 arkadaş çok rahat bir biçimde eve ulaşıp 1 gece konakladık. Ev sahibi Sema hanım ve eşi bizimle ihtiyaçlarımız için sürekli iletişim kurdular ve yardıma ihtiyacımız olduğunda bizzat gelip ilgilendiler. Evde her şey tam ve temizdi. Gönül rahatlığı ile konaklayabilirsiniz.

description:
Located in Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls and cinemas, this unit is waiting to welcome its new residents. It is within walking distance to places such as Taksim, Şişli and Nişantaşı.

High speed Wi-Fi available.
Parking, elevator, 24/7 security, reception.
New & High quality furniture.
You can enjoy the city view from your private balcony.
Please kindly check all the photos for details.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text: The location is perfect, and it is near Taksim Square. The apartment is also very comfortable, with a huge balcony and with all the amenities. Also, the apartment has free parking, and the host, Nihan, is very friendly, and she explained to me everything. So, I highly recommend this apartment.

Burada konaklamak gerçekten harikaydı! Evin dekorasyonu çok zevkliydi ve her yer tertemizdi. Konumu sayesinde gitmek istediğimiz her yere kolayca ulaştık. Ev sahibi her sorumuza çok hızlı ve nazikçe yanıt verdi. Bir sonraki seyahatimde kesinlikle tekrar burada kalmak isterim. Herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim!

An exceptional stay from the moment we arrived until we left. The location is ideal, within easy reach of Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, and many other key spots. The area felt very secure, especially being right beside the Sheraton Hotel. The apartments are beautifully maintained and supported by a 24-hour concierge service, giving the whole stay a real sense of comfort and luxury. What truly stood out, though, were the hosts. They were always available and happy to assist with anything we needed. All in all, it was a wonderful experience.

Perfect Location
Property is Specious, clean with all the eminities.
Near by Bus Station. Host is very generous and responsive.

Tevfik apartment was clean, the building is wonderful, and they are very responsive. They supported us with a storage room for our luggage. 1 concern I faced during my stay is that the matress need to be changed since its not comfortable. Other than that its a 5/5.

description: Explore historic Istanbul from this stylish 2-bedroom apartment. Perfectly located for walking, you're just 3 mins from the seaside and 15 mins from Hagia Sophia & the Blue Mosque. This modern, comfortable home with a dedicated workspace is ideal for couples or small families looking to immerse themselves in the city's vibrant culture. Comfortably fits up to 4 guests.

reviews.text:
This property was newly renovated, clean and affordable. The property was described as 2-bed rooms, kitchen and sitting room. It had a kitchennet but not a sitting room was unexpected. Sink pipe in the bathroom and toilet sink pipes for ablution was not connected. The place is noisy until mid-night due to cafe/restaurant next door. When seagulls sit on the rooftop, you can hear that noise too.
The host himself never turned up or got in touch with us. His brother was in touch and he was helpful. There is a washing machine in the basement and access was provided by his brother upon request. This is good for short term stay and particularly if you don’t stay at home much. Nonetheless, it is not convenient when you don’t have place to drink coffee/tea with friends and family in the morning. There is no lift and it is not good for elderly. The street is not clean and it smells bad which is the case with most streets in the old town like this. Overall this is good for short stay.

One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had—comfortable, spotless, and perfectly located!
The apartment is just steps away from the main tourist area, with late-night restaurants nearby, yet remains quiet and undisturbed by crowds. The host was extremely helpful and responsive—we arrived late at night and also needed assistance storing our luggage after checkout, and they made everything smooth and easy.
All amenities were exactly as described. Just note that you’ll need to climb stairs, so choosing a lower level might be more convenient for some guests.
While everything was lovely, the bathroom lighting was dim during our stay. I’ve already shared this and a few other small suggestions with the host to help improve the experience for future guests.
Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone staying near Sultanahmet!

Great location in walking distance to all the tourist sights and also easy to walk to metro station for days out that were further away. Living space was big enough for three of us to cook in the evenings. Lots of cooking utensils provided. Whole apartment was super clean and cosy. The host was helpful and reserved a Turkish bath for me which she recommended, it was great. We stayed for 8 nights so could have done with the toilet roll being refreshed, we did ask for this but ended up just buying more from the shop ourselves. Some noise from the restaurants at night time but just put earplugs in then we were fine.
Amazing value for money, would definitely recommend this place for people who are visiting Istanbul for the first time.

ev hem çok pisti duvarda sümük vardı, klozet yerinden çıkıyor gibiydi oturmaya korktuk. 4 gün oradaydık ve 4 gün boyunca sıcak su yoktu, tuvaletten çok kötü bir koku geliyordu. mutfak malzemeleri kirliydi. konumu son derece korkunç, kız kıza gidilecek bir yer değil. asansör yok ve merdivenler çok dik. sadece uyumak ve duş almak için tuttuk ama maalesef beklentimizi asla karşılamadı. tek iyi yani ev sahibinin ulaşılabilir olması.

The house was very nice and quite, clean. rooms are big comfortable. mostly owner was always responsive. The service he provided we are very happy with that. and It's located heart of Istanbul. transport easy to get, even famous palaces are in walking distance. ❤️❤️

description:
Experience a beautiful stay in the heart of Istanbul!

This booking offers a stylish studio apartment on a high floor with a clear city view. Located in Pera, you will enjoy easy access to the famous Istiklal Street, prestigious Pera Museum and Soho House, historic Galata Tower, vibrant nightlife, and convenient public transit options, all just minutes away.

Featuring a useful private kitchenette, high-end essentials, daily cleaning, and concierge services, we ensure a memorable vacation!

reviews.text:
The room feels like your own Apt. It's on the 4th floor and there's an elevator. The windows are nice and let it a lot of light but also have curtains for bed time.
The restroom was modern and the kitchen provided a few drinks and ingredients to make tea or coffee which was very kind.
you have the option to have your room cleaned which I thought was a nice perk after a few days of chaotic exploring. lastly, the location was a 5 or so minute walk to the Metro and was close enough to get to the action but far enough for peace. the hosts were communicative and seemed kind and willing to help with any problem that could arrive. would stay again

an absolute oasis in the most beautiful city on earth.
I could not recommend this Airbnb enough!
The location is an absolute delight - about 10 mins walk from Istiklal Avenue with all its shops and late night bars / restaurants and 15 mins from Galata. We even walked back from Karakoy late at night and faced 0 issues - the apartment is located in a very secure and safe area!
The hosts have given such thorough thought to the needs of travellers. Everything was easily accessible and my check in was complete in about 2 minutes. For our checkout, the host also kindly sent some people to assist us with our luggage and helped arrange a taxi to take us to the airport. We felt like we were in a five star hotel and not an Airbnb!
The home was also squeaky clean and cozy. Just the perfect place to rest and decompress after a day of exploring Istanbul. I felt so comfortable that I’ll surely be back 😊

Due to our train connection, we arrived early in Istanbul. We contacted the host and she organized an early check-in for us which was very convenient. The airbnb is easy to find and has a quiet surrounding. The cleaning staff in the building is very friendly and gave us an extra bed sheet. The kitchen is equipped with the bare necessities allowing you to cook very easy meals. Keep in mind that it does not have any salt and pepper. During our stay the internet wasn't very good but the host was very responsive and tried to fix it.
The apartment is located closely to a few grocery stores and restaurants which we appreciated.

Excellent location - walkable to most spots with a bus stop just 2 minutes away. Easy check-in, spotless unit, comfortable bed, great shower, and all basic amenities. A bit smaller than the photos suggest, but overall very happy with the stay.

We had a lovely stay here. Location was excellent, right next to lots of restaurants bars and shops but tucked away in a quiet street so we slept really well. The apartment was also really clean and tidy when we checked in. The price was very reasonable for the area compared to hotels etc. We had a slight issue with accessing the digital key when checking in but contacted the host and they were really helpful and resolved the issue quickly. Would definitely recommend this place if you are looking for great value in a nice area of Istanbul!

description: This spacious studio offers one double bed and a spacious living area. The living area has one large sofa which can be used as a bed for the additional guest. The studio offers a private kitchenette and a private bathroom with mid size Jacuzzi (140cm*80 cm). There is 24 hours door man and once every 2 days room service. The Turkish bath need to be booked upon arrival for free entrance.

reviews.text: Would recommend this place! It was nice, location was good close to the big mosques- lots of convient stores and eateries around, very clean and reception was helpful. When checking in I was given a map and recommended places over complimentary tea and biscuits. There was a nice rooftop overlooking the sea! Quite enjoyed my stay. Things to note as a traveller, shower head is quite short not practical for anyone very 5.5ft, beds were hard and a little uncomfortable, and the location is located near mosques so often you’ll hear prayer calls throughout the day- the first one starting at 5am-6am. Overall would recommend this place, for the price it was very good!

Yusuf and his crew made our stay exceptional! The place was exactly as it looked, very clean and comfortable. We even had room service everyday. Yusuf and his crew very extremely helpful, they arranged a shuttle bus from and to the airport and gave us a lot of tips on order to have the best Isbtabul experience. Wi-fi wasn't working very well in the room but I was always welcomed in the lobby where I was offered a cup of tea or coffe and fresh cookies. The location is very convenient, close to the subway and all major tourists attractions. Yusuf have us a map and guided us trough our stay.
Me and my family loved Yusuf place and we would recommend it to anyone.

Enrol, is a great host and the apartment is exactly as shown in pictures. the bathroom is a bit small in space.
pros
- great staff which is very helpful. will always go out of the way to help
- spacious room with lounge to sit and relax
- fully functional kitchen ( no microwave though)
- location is awesome, right in middle of old city and walking distance to tram and grand Bazaar.
- lots of restuarant to enjoy food around
- on the house tea and coffee
- excellent terrace to enjoy tea coffee / your own drinks
cons
- the view outside the window opens to another building
- TV could have been bigger ( I'm being greedy ;)
- They can carry extra blanket. one night I was cold and since all blankets were out for laundry, I was given a comforter

Very very nice stay! I definitely recommend it! Really!
We stayed at Yusuf's place, and we met him, his brother as well as Erol, a very cool guy working with them. They're are all extremely nice, helpful and welcoming hosts.
The appartment is very clean, tidy and comfortable! The Sauna is also very good! It's exactly as it appears in the pictures.
The first night, we were late for the check-in and Yusuf's brother helped us to book the shuttle from the airport. The next day Yusuf gave us plenty of useful indications and good ideas for things to do or places to visit. He recommended also for us a very nice restaurant nearby.
We had many interesting discussions with Yusuf and Erol about politics and history of Turkey, around a warm cup of tea.
The appartment is on the historical center close to all monuments (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sofia, Topkapi palace..). The neighbourhood is very quiet and safe by night. I completely recommend it!

The best thing about this place is the hospitality! We were welcomed with open arms, and offered tea and cookies (the way to my heart). Our room was exactly as advertised. The only negative thing I have to comment on is the wifi. I'm not sure if it was on our end or what but it didn't work our entire stay. We only stayed one night, and didn't really need it so it wasn't a big deal for us.. but just an FYI for those who may need it. Considering that's the only bad thing I have to say, this Airbnb is worth it just for the hospitality and accommodation. We arrived a little earlier than check in time, but were made to feel comfortable while we waited (those cookies!) During that waiting time we witnessed a lot of check outs and how happy others were with their stay. Which is how we felt at our check out. Yusuf called us a cab to take us to the airport, which was very helpful and much appreciated because we were completely unfamiliar with the area and language. Would definitely stay here again.

description: Our hotel is completely renovated and in a great location, within walking distance of Nişantaşı and Taksim.

reviews.text: The hotel is perfect! It has everything you might need, the location is in a quiet area and everything is close by. The staff is very kind, polite and responsive. Would definitely recommend and come again.

İstanbul’a her yıl 3 kere geliyoruz her gelişimizde burayı tercih ediyoruz çünkü çok merkezi ve çok temiz bir yer. Gideceğiniz her yere çok yakın metro ve Nişantaşı’na yürüyerek 2 dakika. Çalışanları da güler yüzlü, yatak ve banyo pırıl pırıl. Şiddetle tavsiye ediyorum.
New hotel was like any budget hotel. The staff on the other hand were amazing! Everyone was nice, friendly and helpful. They went the extra mile for me
Konum güzel çalışanlar çok ilgili odalar rahat
Her sey çok guzel geçti. Otel cok temizdi ve konumu cok iyidi. Butun calisanlar her konuda yardimci oldular. Tesekkur ediyorum :)

description: Experience this historic place, an old Greek house in a 100-year-old building. We are at your service as a 5-room luxury boutique hotel that blends historical charm with modern comfort. Be our guest for a peaceful and unique stay while being within walking distance of restaurants and cafes.

reviews.text: We were warmly welcomed upon arrival, which made us feel right at home. The room was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location of the hotel is very central, with everything within walking distance. I will definitely visit again. Highly recommended!

Giriş ve çıkışlarda hiçbir sorun yaşamadım. Oda tam olarak fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi,,temiz ve güzeldi. Konumu gerçekten çok iyiydi. Tahta zeminler nedeniyle ufak bir ses olabiliyor ama beni hiç rahatsız etmedi. Genel olarak tekrar konaklamak isteyeceğim bir yer. Mahzen Otel’e tekrar teşekkürler…
Very clean, peaceful and comfortable room in a historic building. Awesome neighborhood (Karakolhane st especially). Recommended!

Great location and overall a very pleasant stay.
One thing to be aware of: the bathroom is positioned on the side of the room, with clear glass with limited privacy. Fine if you’re comfortable with that, but something to consider depending on who you’re traveling with.
Also, sound insulation is minimal. You can clearly hear the upstairs neighbors, even normal walking echoes through the room.
Aside from these points, the room itself was good and the stay was enjoyable.
We stayed in the room with the balcony, it was so cute and clean. It was only an 8 minute walk from the bus station and had great options for restaurants around the hotel.

description:
📍 Modern 2-bedroom apartment in Kadıköy/Bostancı
🚇 1 min to the subway, 7 min to Marmaray
🏬 Walking distance to Bagdat Avenue
✈️ Sabiha Gökçen Airport: 32 min
🕌 Sultanahmet, Galataport, Sirkeci: 35 min
⛴ Ferry to the Islands and European Side: 27 min
🏢 Secure site, indoor/outdoor parking, elevator
🏗 New and earthquake-resistant building
🍽 Fully equipped kitchen, 3-person accommodation capacity📶 Wi-Fi, air conditioning, smart TV
🛠 Professional management: Köylüm Group
📅 Suitable for long-term stays

reviews.text:
The apartment was generally Goood, but there were few important issues that significantly affected my stay.
The main is that there is no AC in the bedrooms. Only one AC unit located in the kitchen/living area, which is definitely not sufficient during some hot summer days in Istanbul.
Also, there were no cleaning materials or basic cleaning supplies provided at all, which is inconvenient, especially for a longer stay.
Another issue was the noise from the next-door neighbor, which was quite disturbing, particularly over the nights.
Evin düzeni ve temizliği gayet iyi,, herşey düzenli. konum olarak da iyi bir yerde
It was a great place. I really appreciated the flexibility with the check-in and check-out times
Gayet güzel konforlu ve heryere yakın
Great place in Bostanci metro around the corner shop very close to it. Just a good place. Nice pool.

description: The apartment has a large, spacious and modern furnished living room with a view of the Bosphorus, a balcony, a kitchen, a toilet, 2 bedrooms with double beds and 1 dressing room.

reviews.text:
The accommodation left a truly wonderful impression. The apartment was very tidy, clean, and cozy, fully matching the description and photos. The location is convenient — the city center is easily accessible, and the view from the windows is simply breathtaking.
The host was extremely kind, caring, and helpful, making the entire stay smooth and worry-free.
I sincerely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable, pleasant, and memorable stay. We will definitely come back again! 🇹🇷❤️🧿

We absolutely loved this apartment. Admittedly, with the Istanbul streets and stairs we suffered a little until we got there (advise to take a taxi) but Cengiz was very accommodating and helpful, offering to carry our bags through the stairs in the neighborhood and the apartment. The apartment itself is better than the photos, the effect of the view cannot be fully described and we simply did not want to leave. We would definitely stay again and again, this was the best view of Istanbul for the price and for the quality. Thanks for everything.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul! The apartment itself is beautifully decorated with great furniture and a very clean space, making it feel cozy and welcoming. The location was also convenient for exploring the city.
One thing to note is that access with luggage can be a bit challenging since there are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment, and there’s no elevator. However, despite this, the host was incredibly responsive, responsible, and went above and beyond to help with the luggage, which made all the difference.
Overall, I have no complaints—it was a fantastic stay, and I truly appreciate the host’s hospitality. Would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a stylish and comfortable place in Istanbul!

Overall great location with an amazing view! The host helped us with our luggage, recommended parking locations, and brought us extra water which was very helpful! Keep in mind when booking here there are a lot of stairs and might not be accessible for everyone, but the view is worth the climb!

This is a decent place, nice location, clean, but desperately needs renovation, it has basic stuff, good beds and everything works, but everything is so old, and pictures look better then reality, but THE VIEW is as good as it’s shown, depending on how much you value it. But I definitely liked it

description:
Located at a luxury residence close to the Old Town and Taksim Sq.

Unit is located ın the 7th floor.

10 minutes to Galataport by car
15 minutes to Taksim Sq. and Istiklal by walk.

15 minutes to Nisantasi Shopping District by car
25 minutes to Zorlu Shopping Mall.

Guests are required to provide Passport/ID info to the host during check-in bylaw

reviews.text: Everything was exactly as described in the listing. The host was very responsive and communication was seamless. The location is perfect — close to all the main attractions and hotspots. Really enjoyed the stay and would happily book again.

Mr Ekin was Very helpful, lovely place as in the photos .
The place also was clean .
For sure I’ll be back again .
Beautiful apartment, comfortable, clean, in the very center, everything is there for living. Near all the shops. Safe accommodation. Great owner, always on call, helped and answered all questions.

Very responsive and professional host. I forgot the keys inside the apartment and I messaged at 1 o clock in the morning and he responded very quick. There was a spare key with reception and I got back inside in less than 10 minutes. I would definitely recommend any property this host has and I will book again with them. The apartment was very nice and the underground parking was also very good. The check in was super easy and quick and the property was easy to find. Overall I would definitely recommend and the apartment is very nice! Thank you I really enjoyed my stay :)

I enjoyed my stay at Ekin’s place. The flat is cozy and lives up to the description, felt like a home away from home.
The neighborhood is very convenient, with cafes and supermarkets close by. Taksim square and İstiklal street are a 20 minute walk although it’s a steep climb!!
Host is responsive and always there to help should the need arise. All in all we enjoyed our time in Istanbul and would happily stay here again!

description:
ALEX - Located in the center of KADIKÖY. The center is only a few steps away from Moda and the Rıhtıma (Port). You can walk to the Seaside in 1 minute. Our apartment has well-equipped new furniture. We try to think of everything for your comfort.

Entertainment Centers are Here

reviews.text: Oda gayet güzel ve temizdi, konum olarak tam olması gerektiği yerde cadde kalabalık geceleri ses oluyor ancak uyumaya engel olduğunu düşünmüyorum oda da klima ve diğer şeyler sorunsuz bir şekilde çalışıyor. Serpil hanım ile iletişim konusunda problem yaşamadık mesajlarimiza hemen cevap verdi. Gayet güzel fiyatına göre güzel bir yer öneriyorum rahatlıkla tercih edebilirsiniz.

Excellent location, just a few minutes’ walk from the ferry terminal and metro, with easy access to all parts of Istanbul. The place is exactly as described, and the team was very responsive with excellent communication both before and during my stay. The area is very safe and lively throughout the night, so if you’re a light sleeper, you may want to bring earplugs. I would definitely recommend this place!

İlk geldiğimizde resepsiyon boştu 5-10dk beklemek zorunda kaldık, daha sonra bize verilen odanın temizlenmemiş olduğunu gördük. Aşağı indiğimizde bize başka bir oda verdiler, verilen bu oda da “temiz” di ama çok ağır bir sigara kokusu vardı. Biz binanın arka tarafında kaldığımız için içeriye hiç ışık gelmiyordu hapishane gibiydi, ön tarafta kalsak da muhtemelen çok ses gelecekti diye tahmin ediyorum. Yatak gıcırdıyordu, çekmecelerden birinde bi poşet kalmıştı, genel olarak kötü bir deneyimdi. Aynı fiyata çevrede daha iyi yerler var, başka yerlere bakmanız daha mantıklı olacaktır muhtemelen

We had just had a spot that didn't work for us. We booked in one day, got a great centrally located place, got great value, elevator, and couldn't have been happier with this place. A block from everything Kadikoy offers. Amazing
Konumu iyi, iletişim rahat, sakinlik ön planda

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
The location of the accommodation was very convenient, and we could walk to almost everywhere. However, the road leading to the accommodation is quite steep, with both uphill and downhill sections, which can be difficult, especially when carrying luggage.
The accommodation has everything you would need for a short stay. Selma was also very kind and helpful, and a few times she brought us the things we needed with a friendly attitude.
Unfortunately, the mattress was uneven and not very comfortable, and the sofa was not very clean.
Overall, Selma and the people working there were very kind, friendly, and always willing to help.

The room is quite big, they are very friendly and upgraded my room, I love the room itself, it even comes with a kitchen and dining table with powdering table and mirror. However, the bathroom is a little bit smelly, the environment nearby was very loud at night and bright. Except these, it’s a good price and okay accommodation.
We had great time and the place was awesome. Great location and lovely host!
Fiyatına göre konumu harika taksim meydana 5 dk yürüme mesafesinde.Tek sorun klima düzgün çalışmıyordu onun dışında herhangi bir sorun yoktu
Resepsiyon ev sahibi cok yardimci oldular. Konum olarak mukemmel, taksim meydanina yuruyerek 3-4 dakika. Iki kiz olarak guvenle konakladik, tesekkurler her sey icin

description: These similar Luxury Life Suites are ideally located in Yenibosna's bustling neighborhood, offering guests easy access to numerous tourist attractions and essential services. Just minutes away, you'll find the bustling CNR Expo Center, perfect for business travelers attending conferences and exhibitions. For entertainment and shopping, Starcity Outlet Center offers a wide variety of stores and dining options.

reviews.text:
I am a very picky person when it comes to staying anywhere other than my own home, but this simple 2-bedroom apartment truly felt like home. It was perfectly clean, the bed was comfortable, and it had great air conditioning. The location is unbeatable—within walking distance to public transportation and surrounded by lots of places to eat. At night, it was incredibly quiet and peaceful (our apartment, 202, faced the alley).
The crew was simply GREAT. The staff took care of our requests with emergency-level speed—seriously, every request was handled in under 5 minutes! Miss Gomze (with her lovely smile), Mr. Hamza, Cesur, and Azat were at the reception 24/7 to make sure we were completely comfortable.
Mrs. Bedia kept the place spotless. I hope she reads this review and knows how much we appreciated her hard work.
Thank you, Mr. Mustafa, for a pleasant stay. You did an awesome job hiring people

My stay was perfect. The rooms were spacious and had everything I needed, including all the necessary household appliances. The beds were very comfortable, the fridge was surprisingly large, and every room had air conditioning. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again.
Çok rahat bulduk konum olarak güzel bir yerde. Konaklama hizmetlerinden memnun kaldık ilk arayacağımız yer
Genel olarak karşılama olsun rahatlık olsun gayet iyiydi, evdeki fonksiyonlar eksiksiz çalışıyordu güzel ve temiz bi konaklama oldu teşekkürler
Gerçekten evimiz gibi hissettirdi metroya da çok yakın oldupu için ulaşım açısından sıkıntı yaşamadık

description: Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space.

reviews.text: Ev gerçekten fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi. Temizlik, düzen ve konfor açısından hiçbir eksik yoktu. Ev sahibi çok ilgili ve hızlı dönüş yaptı. Konum olarak da oldukça avantajlıydı. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

Ev gayet temiz ve güzeldi ev sahibiyle de rahat iletişim kurabiliyorduk. Tek sıkıntı tam yanımızdaki evde inşaat vardı ve çitlerin üstünden işçiler bizi biz onları görebiliyorduk. Biraz rahatsız ediciydi.

Arkadaşımın doğum günü için kiraladık. Konum olarak sessiz ve huzurlu bir yerdi. Ev sahibi ihtiyacımız ne olursa karşılamaya çalıştı. Ev temizdi ve gerekli eşyalar vardı. Havuz doluydu ve temizdi. Daha sonra da kalmak isteyeceğim bir yer. Teşekkürler her şey için.

Her ne kadar gittiğimizde temizlik bitmemiş olsa ve bi 45dk beklemek zorunda kalsak da her şey gayet güzeldi. Çıkış saati esnetilerek gönlümüz alındı. Sorun olarak söyleyebileceğim tek şey wifi hizmeti. 1mbps bile olmayan bir internet hizmeti mevcut ki telefonların zaman zaman çekmediği bir bölgede hayati bir hizmet eksikliği. Bunun haricinde diğer hizmetler anlatıldığı gibiydi.
Her şey çok güzeldi. Her yer temiz ve hijyenikti. Konum harikaydı. Havuz tertemizdi. Kesinlikle parasının hakkını sonuna kadar veriyor. Her şey için çok teşekkürler.

description: I'm a psychologist and I like to travel. It is a pleasure to host you, our guests, in Istanbul, which has hosted many civilizations of the world. You can reach the subway, airport shuttle, bus, many historical places and cafes in 10-15 minutes on foot from the apartment located in a newly restored historical building about 350 meters from Taksim Square. Hot water, central heating system, TV, air conditioning, and well-functioning Wi-Fi are available at all times. Cleanliness is our top priority.

reviews.text: Decent accommodation for the price. Very clean place, both bedroom and bathroom. The location is hilly but it's quite close (10 - 15 min walk) both to Taksim square in order to go downtown, and to a multi-bus stop if you'd like to explore other areas. Near the room, there are three regular super markets, a lokanta (buffet restaurant) and a burek place with cheap prices for the budget conscious traveller. An area of more touristy mini markets and restaurants can be found within a 500m radius as well. We visited during a snowy week and thankfully central heating was on all day at a comfortable temperature, neither too hot nor too cold. Additionally there was an air conditioner but we didn't use it. Before coming, we received detailed information from the hosts. Although we didn't really need anything, I feel they would have helped out if we did. In general I would highly recommend this place, honest price for what it offers.

Everything was wonderful... a warm room in the cold winter of Istanbul... a clean bathroom with hot water and very excellent momentum... the place is very clean. The location is central...and the owner is cooperative in every way and at all times. I thank him very much

The best location in central Beyoglu, Istanbul. Great comfortable bed and fast WiFi also.
The hosts are very kind and welcoming too. Real Turkish hospitality!
Had a great stay at the airbnb, room was as shown and described. We had a problem with a water leak on the last day but the hosts responded fast and handled it well 👍
ev temiz fotoğrafta göründüğü gibiydi muhitin etrafı konum olarak pek iyi değildi özellikle akşam saatinde fakat bir sorun yaşamadık genel olarak fiyat performans açısından gayet iyi memnun kaldık

description: Would you like to stay in the heart of Istanbul at our chic and modern 2-bedroom Beyoglu short-term rental flat Ikebana? Located just 5 minutes from iconic landmarks like Taksim Square, Istiklal Avenue, and Galata Tower, you will be at the nexus of the city's vibrant culture. Book now and dive into the rhythm of Istanbul in our fully furnished flat with a spacious interior and a balcony!

reviews.text: Apartment was clean but there were some stains on the beds and towels. There was no hot water when we first arrived but Ali was very helpful and responded fast helping us whenever we needed it. He was a wonderful host!

The location is great, but I didn’t find the interior of the house sufficient in terms of price–performance for single occupancy. The kitchen appliances could have been more adequate, but the host responded very quickly to one of my requests, which I really appreciate. I can also mention that there is a technical issue with the TV, although I am not a frequent user.

Ev fotoğraflarda mükemem görünüyordu fakat gerçekte öyle değildi.evin temizliği yüzeysel yapılmıştı, çarşaf ve yastıklarda lekeler vardı.İnternet ile işiniz varsa evde internet çalışmıyordu.Evin konumu güzel ulaşımı kolaydı.

The apartment was very spacious and located in a calm, safe, and perfect area. The interior design is outstanding, with beautiful colors that make the place feel welcoming and stylish. The air conditioning worked perfectly, making the stay very comfortable. The only small suggestion I have is to improve the lighting in the apartment, as it could make the space feel even better. Overall, a wonderful stay and highly recommended!

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Eve ilk girdiğimiz andan itibaren kendimizi rahat hissettik. Her şey özenle hazırlanmıştı ve ihtiyacımız olan her şeyi bulduk. Ev sahibi çok nazik, yardımsever ve iletişimi gerçekten çok kolaydı. Konumu da gezmek için oldukça uygundu. Buradan güzel anılarla ayrıldık. Yolumuz tekrar düşerse hiç düşünmeden yine burada kalırız. Herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

description: Our apartment is just a 3-minute walk from Istiklal Street and Şişhane Metro! Stay in the heart of Istanbul with easy access to cafes, shops, and transport. This 3-bedroom apartment has everything for a comfortable stay: high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, Smart TV with Netflix, dishwasher, and more. The whole place is yours to enjoy!

reviews.text:
I have controversial thoughts about this place:
Let’s list advantages first:
1. Nice and quite place
2. Responsive host
3. Big apartment with a stripe of the Bosphorus strait as a bonus)
4. Fridge, cooker, plates, cups
Now the disadvantages:
1. The apartment surely needs maintenance - broken handles in wardrobes; some parts of baseboard were broken
2. Wi-Fi worked ONLY in one room (living room). There were 4 of us, If everyone wanted to use Wi-Fi at the same time, it disconnected.
3. Dirty floor. Our white socks became dark after walking around the flat. The cleaner didn’t perform their job properly. Dirty cups, dishes and cutlery. Dirty towel (one had some yellow stripe)
4. No shampoo, shower wash, even a soap.
If these small imperfections are eliminated, the flat will be an amazing place to stay!

Me and friends had a nice time here. The location is quite nice, it’s near the high street and tube station. The flat is clean in general, only that the heating on 2nd floor didn’t work so it was bit cold during the night. The bedrooms are cozy, only that the bathrooms are bit narrow.

We very much enjoyed our stay. The apartment was as described- having the second bathroom was very handy! Walkable to public transport, shopping etc
The third bedroom is more of an open loft space with a single bed but it suited us.
Would recommend.

wifi was down the entire trip which was a big problem for us. although listing said shower gel and shampoo was provided, only one set was provided although there were two bathrooms
however, the place was extremely clean and the host was super responsive. they also provided an alternative (this one) when the previous one that we booked had an issue
Overall a good place. Well equiped kitchen. Responsive host. Lift is a bit small if you are coming with family or big luggage.

description:
Stay in a beautifully restored 105-year-old historic building located in the very heart of Karaköy—one of Istanbul’s most vibrant, artistic and walkable neighborhoods. Every floor hosts one private apartment, offering rare privacy and comfort in an unbeatable location just 3 minutes from the tram, ferry and bus.

Whether you’re here for culture, gastronomy, business or a weekend getaway, this home offers the perfect blend of history, design and convenience.

reviews.text:
THE PROS ✅
1) location, location, location (could not have asked for better)
2) well decorated and modern place
3) responsive and friendly host
THE CONS ⚠️
1) we traveled in late May and when I made the booking, I checked for AC in the amenities but did not read the fine print that it was only during a limited time of the year… therefore we did not have AC (which I would have not made the booking knowing this)
2) no AC meant we had to open the windows, and due to the great location, the noise was VERY loud (especially with prayer at 4am, trash pickup at 5am, then street cleaning at 6am)
3) open windows meant we got A LOT of mosquitos and mosquito bites
Understanding this, the airbnb would’ve been perfect June - September when they turn on the AC.

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment and loved staying in this part of Istanbul. The surrounding neighborhoods were full of cafes, restaurants, and shops. And we enjoyed a nearby hamam.
The property itself was easy to access and was comfortable, though it looks more elegant in photos than in person. The layout is a little odd with the kitchen being part of the foyer. And the bathroom is attached to the main room. There is not much privacy from a sliding bathroom door, just to note depending on the company you are traveling with. The black out curtains were helpful to keep out lights from the city. Lots of towels were provided which is always nice. The couch was a comfy place to hang out.
Thanks for a nice stay.

I can highly recommend this apartment. It's a one minute walk to the Bosphorus and tram stop which takes you to all the main tourist sites. There's lots of excellent nearby restaurants including all the seafood restaurants along the water. The apartment itself is big and spacious, and very clean. We thought the beds and shower in particular were very good. Note that the apartment is on the first floor with no lift. The only slight downside I would say is that it can be very noisy overnight as its such a central location. If you're a light sleeper you will hear the 4.30am call to prayer so bring earplugs. Apart from that I would definitely stay again!
Yer temiz, rahat ve fotoğrafta ki gibiydi , ev sahibi çok nazik ve yardımseverdi. Kesinlikle herkese tavsiye ederim.

Very pretty, comfortable, spacious apartment.
2 min walk to Galata Bridge. T1 tram stop and ferry around the corner. Great location to explore the essential tourist attractions. Some nice restaurants around. There's a nice bar downstairs where you can get breakfast or have a drink in the evening.

reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay at this location. All staff and the host are super nice. They even upgraded us to a double bed as I mistakenly booked two singles.
The property is in a busy but very safe area and we couldn’t hear the outside noise in our hotel.
The hotel is exactly as described, offers great value for money and it’s in a fantastic location making it easy to access all of İstanbul, including the Asian side as the ferry terminals are quite close.
The room’s were clean, and exactly as described. Good flow in the shower and perfect Air conditioning.
There are lots of positives about this hotel and ultimately I would recommend staying here. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because the lock on our room didn’t work. We flagged this with reception and they gave us a physical key but the lock was always open when we returned. We also put on the button requesting our room to be cleaned each day, however it was never cleaned.

Perfect stay in the heart of the city!
​I had a fantastic experience staying here. The location is unbeatable—very central with all the amenities you could need and some truly great restaurants nearby. Plus, being within walking distance of the Blue Mosque made sightseeing so easy.
​The room itself was spotless and well-equipped with a very comfortable bed. The bathroom was equally clean, and the shower was excellent. I also appreciated the flexibility of being able to come and go as I pleased, with the staff always available to help book taxis or provide local recommendations.
​My family stayed elsewhere nearby, and after visiting me, they were incredibly impressed by how spacious and clean my room was compared to theirs. I’ll definitely be staying here again!

Daha öncede İstanbul’a bir çok kez geldim bu nedenle İstanbul’da düzenli ve güvenli bir şekilde konaklama yapmak benim için önemliydi konum olarak her yere çok rahat ulaşabileceğiniz bir yerde hemen önünde Marmara’ya inen asansör var iki dk yürüme mesafesinde de tramvaylar var fotoğraflarda oda ile aynı odaya sahiptik gerçekten fiyat performans aynı zamanda çalışanlar çok misafirperverdi çok sevdik resepsiyonda bizi karşılayan hanımefendi ve beyfendi ayrıca orda bulunan hizmetlide aynı şekilde çok memnun kaldık oda manzarası yok ara bi yere bakıyordu benim odam ama zaten manzaralı bir yer olmasına dikkat etmiyordum ben o nedenle bir sorun değildi gece uyurkende ne sokaktan bir ses nede kattan herhangi bir ses de duymadık son olarak uçağım akşam saatinde olduğu içim eşyalarımı bırakmama izin verdiler bu nedenle çok teşekkür ediyorum bir sonraki İstanbul’a geldiğimde kesinlikle tercih edeceğim bir yer olacak iyi çalışmalar dilerim
Herkesede tavsiye ediyorum ❤️🙏🏻

This hotel’s staff is very friendly and helpful. The place itself is okay for the price. A few things to note: the twin beds are not that wide and the bedsheets feel quite worn but everything else was good.

So from the start to the end the process was 10/10.
The staff there were too friendly and talkative, even we found ourselves welcomed as we at our home.
I want to thank the staff for their work, especially the Son of the owner.
The location is perfect, everything you want is near, restaurants, metro/tram and exchange/Doviz.

description:
✨ A Historical and Fascinating Accommodation in Galata ✨
Feel the spirit of Istanbul in this private house where history and modern comfort meet. Enjoy this unique city with your family…

reviews.text: We loved our stay at Emin’s place. Clean, very well located, easy to get to public transport. The kitchenette is small but we didn’t do any cooking; the bathroom is big and clean; the living room is bigger than it looks in the photos; the bed is big. The streets of istanbul everywhere seem to be quite noisy through the night so if you’re a light sleeper you should bring good earplugs. But the place is great, Emin is a really good host who responds almost immediately every time and is quick to check in on any needs you might have. All was good!!!

We had a great time! The home was very clean and comfortable and Emin was a super helpful and responsive host. There were several great restaurants within walking distance and it was easy to navigate the city while close to the metro. We would definitely stay here again!

Emin's communication was excellent throughout the process! Very responsive and guided us the whole way. His apartment is located in a perfect location with access to the tram and bus, shopping, famous mosques , restaurants, and close to the waterfront. The apartment is comfortable and nicely furnished. Very happy we stayed here!

The space is beautiful and immaculately clean. The local neighborhood is wonderful, but the street corner is very loud - expect music from the bar across the street, ambient voices, and moped engines throughout most of the day. The wifi was incredibly slow. Last, I had to wait about 20 minutes after check in for the cleaners to finish their work. This all being said, the place was gorgeous and the host was easily reachable, I would stay there again

Our stay was okay overall, but there were a few things that were quite disappointing. The toilet flush button was broken, and the shower switch didn't work properly, which made using the bathroom inconvenient every day.
The biggest issue for us was the internet. It was extremely slow, around 2 MB/s.
The apartment itself could also use some cosmetic updates, and it's located right next to a busy road, so it's noticeably noisy.
Other than that, everything was fine, and the place has potential. However, considering the condition of the apartment and these issues, I think the price is a bit too high and should be lower. If slow internet and a few maintenance problems don't bother you, you may still enjoy your stay.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
AVOID AT ALL COSTS! This property was a major disappointment. Critical information was not disclosed in the listing: it is located on a pedestrian-only street, so taxis cannot reach the entrance, and the apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator, accessed only by very narrow stairs.
The building entrance is through a bar, which raises serious security concerns as anyone can access the apartment. The building and apartment itself are poorly maintained and unclean. The kitchen appliances were greasy and inadequately equipped, the bathroom was not hygienic, the shower head was broken, and several electrical outlets were loose and sparked when used. Also an extremely old AC covered with plastic.
The noise from surrounding bars was very loud and made it extremely difficult to sleep.
I do not understand how Airbnb allows properties like this to remain listed. We had to request a full refund due to the misleading listing, safety concerns, and unacceptable condition of the place.

Çok güzel bir 2 gunluk konaklamaydı. Ev beşiktaşın merkezinde. Alt katında mekanlar var. Gece geç saatlere kadar ev sahibinin önden de bilgilendirdiği gibi müzik gürültüsü var. Beni severim benim için sorun yaratmadı. Konum mukemmel. Ev sahibi ilgili. Yeniden konaklarım rezervasyon bulabilirsem.
Ev temizdi ve konaklamamız genel olarak sorunsuz geçti. Ev sahibi iletişime açıktı, teşekkür ederiz.
Ev temizdi, örtüler ve havlular temizdi, her şey fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Sadece biraz gürültülüydü o da benim için çok sorun olmadı. Birdaha gelirsem yine burayı tercih ederim
Her şey harikaydı.Özellikle konumu ve temizliği çok iyi.Bundan sonra hep önceliğim olacak.

description: Bright and stylish 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of Cihangir, Beyoğlu with breathtaking Bosphorus and sea views. Filled with natural light, the home features a spacious living room, modern design, and a beautiful terrace perfect for relaxing with family or friends. Located steps away from Istanbul’s best cafés, restaurants, galleries, and nightlife, while offering a peaceful and comfortable stay in one of the city’s most charming neighborhoods.

reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful house in Istanbul. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The house was exceptionally clean, spotless, fresh, and very well maintained. Every room, bathroom, the kitchen, furniture, and living areas were perfectly prepared and extremely comfortable.
The house is spacious and ideal for a family, with everything needed for a relaxing stay. One of the biggest highlights is the amazing view — even more beautiful than the photos. Waking up to it every morning and enjoying the peaceful atmosphere in the evening made our stay truly special.
The hospitality was outstanding. The host was extremely kind, welcoming, respectful, and always available whenever we needed anything. Communication was excellent, and we genuinely felt cared for throughout our stay.
A fantastic experience from beginning to end. We felt completely at home and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended . 10/10 and 5 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I had one of the most unforgettable stays in Istanbul here — honestly one of the best vacations I’ve ever had. The apartment is in the heart of Cihangir, one of the city’s most vibrant and charming neighborhoods, full of amazing cafés, restaurants, bars, and beautiful streets.
The view was absolutely breathtaking, and waking up there every morning felt surreal. The apartment itself was stylish, peaceful, extremely comfortable, and equipped with everything you could need. Every detail felt thoughtfully prepared.
Most importantly, the host was incredibly kind, understanding, responsive, and welcoming throughout the entire stay. The apartment was also spotless — truly one of the cleanest Airbnbs I’ve stayed in.
Between the comfort, the incredible location, and the hospitality, this place exceeded all my expectations. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

We had a great stay! The home was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was kind, helpful, and very responsive throughout our stay. Everything went smoothly, and we really enjoyed our time here. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality — I would definitely recommend this place to others!

Staying here completely changed my experience of Istanbul in the best possible way. The apartment is perfectly located in the center of Cihangir, surrounded by incredible cafés, restaurants, bars, and the kind of atmosphere that makes you want to stay outside all day and night exploring the city.
The view was stunning both during the day and at night, and the apartment itself felt like a peaceful escape in the middle of all the energy. Everything was spotless, beautifully designed, very comfortable, and had all the amenities you could need for a perfect stay.
The host was amazing from start to finish — extremely kind, helpful, responsive, and caring. You can really feel the effort put into making guests feel comfortable and welcome.
I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs before, but this one truly stands out. If you want to experience Istanbul properly while staying in a beautiful, cozy, and perfectly located home, this place is an easy recommendation.
Great household, friendly, and responsive. Also the balcony and the view are amazing just as described

description: Located in Beyoğlu, one of Istanbul's most historic districts, this elegantly restored apartment promises a peaceful stay. Its location puts you very close to the city's most central areas. The building features a beautiful and spacious lobby area, a shared space where you can enjoy your time and socialize with other guests. You can also enjoy coffee and tea while staying in the building with our unlimited Wi-Fi service. Please note that we do not accept guests without reservations

reviews.text:
The apartment was very comfortable and had everything I needed for my stay. It was clean, well-equipped, and even had a kitchen where I could prepare simple meals.
The only downside was that there were many children playing in the neighborhood, sometimes even late at night, and the sound insulation wasn’t the best. However, I still found the room comfortable and it didn’t affect my sleep.
Overall, I had a pleasant stay and would recommend this place.
Excellent stay! Clean, cozy, great location, and an amazing host. Everything was perfect. Highly recommended and would definitely stay again.

Eşimle birlikte 4 günlük İstanbul tatilimizi geçirdiğimiz tatlı bir AirBnbydi. Konumu oldukça merkezi ve giriş oldukça esnekti masterlock sayesinde. Oda görsellerdeki gibiydi ve açıkçası fiyat kalite oldukça orantılıydı. Özellikle Edip Bey oldukça ilgiliydi kendisine çok teşekkür ederiz. Tekrar geleceğiz. 🙏🏻
