Ulaşım bölgelerine yakın ve temizlik konusunda kusursuzdu. Emeği geçen herkesin eline sağlık. Çok keyifli bir konaklama geçirdim

description: If you stay at this centrally located place, you and your family will be close to everywhere. Our apartment is in the very heart of Istanbul and very close to all the tourist attractions. I am ready to do my best for the happiness of you, our valued guests. I will always be nearby for you in case of any need. Welcome in advance :)

reviews.text: The apartment was great, very clean and comfortable, the very comfortable bed deserves to be mentioned too. The host was very nice and proactive, always helped. The only slight issues are that the wifi works on and off, sometimes going down for a couple of seconds, and the lack of power outlets. But these are minor and dont really matter that much. The incredibly comfortable location deserves a mention too, located close to both galataport and the taksim square. Overall it was a great stay, would recommend, and probably will come back.

We had a good time at this place! It is in a pretty good area with lots of cats and we enjoyed the room itself. I did think that the room was a bit bigger based on the pictures, but I didn’t look at it too closely either. So it’s more like a hotel room than an apartment. Also, the walls are super thin! Unfortunately we had some loud neighbors and you could hear just about everything. So just be prepared for thin walls. But everything else was great! Check in was good and communication was great!
Great place to stay in Istanbul, clean tidy, with lovely view, and a prime location. Bekir was such a lovely host
Daire fotoğraflar da göründüğü gibiydi. konum, temizlik ve manzara hepsi çok iyiydi. Ayrıca Bekir Bey her konuda yardımcı oldu. Kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğiz.
Fotoğraftaki gibi, genel olarak iyi. Konum merkezi ve güzel. İletişim kolaydı. Dolapta su vb bir şey yoktu ve yatak altı tozluydu onun dışında f/p

description: Welcome to your cozy and stylish home in the heart of Taksim!

reviews.text:
Not sure if I have anything nice to say.
Location: Yes, it’s close to Taksim but what’s not told is that you have to climb a really deep hill. I was with my parents(70 yo), so I had to call uber to/from this place regardless of where we go. The neighborhood seemed shady.
Place: It was not as it’s described fully. Post says that it’s on top floor with 2 balconies and AC in the living room, ours was at the entrance and we didn’t have any of these. There’s no sign outside that shows the building#. So you’re blindfolded.
Amenities: I work from home but internet did not work until my last couple of hours in there. TV does not work at all. No AC. Beds are very uncomfortable. Phone networks barely work from that place. Stayed 2 days and in our first day we woke up to no water, and second day no electricity. Apparently someone was working in the building and kept cutting the service with no notice.
Both nights we stayed were extremely noisy. The walls are as tiny as paper.

Daire fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibiydi. konumu olarak merkezi bir konumda Taksim meydana birkaç dakika mesafedeydi. Türker Bey'in daha evvel yine sahibi olduğu dairelerde konaklama fırsatım olmuştu.Mesajlara hızlı dönüt sağlayan ve sorunu hemen çözen bir ev sahibi. Daha evvel olduğu gibi gönül rahatlığıyla ve güvenle konaklamak için tecih edilebilir, misafirperver tutumu için çok teşekkür ederim tavsiye ediyorum

The apartment was exactly like the pictures and description. It was clean and had everything I needed. The location was also great, about a 10-minute walk from Taksim Square. The only downside was that the walk from the apartment to Taksim has some uphill roads, which can be a little tiring. Overall, I had a great stay and would recommend it.
Nice place. Owner is very friendly and responsive.
Gayet güvenilir ve rahat bir konaklama oldu.

description:
Luna Room is a stylish room that combines comfort and modern design in a historic building in the heart of Taksim. With its comfortable bed, private bathroom and basic amenities you may need, it is ideal for both short vacations and business trips. With its location within walking distance to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, it offers a central and practical accommodation experience for guests who want to explore Istanbul.
Note: This room is non-smoking.

reviews.text: Great location near Taksim though very peaceful. Host is proactive and responsive and the place is super clean. Only drawback is for couples because the double bed with two twins put together.
We had a lovely stay! The place was clean and comfortable, and the host was very kind and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay.🌻

I booked this accommodation for my brother and he was quite happy with his stay. I requested an early check-in option which was accepted at a small extra fee. The host was always responsive and helped my brother Check in early which was a relief. The room is a perfect place for short and long stay. It is spotless which gave a good feeling to my brother. Overall, my brother was absolutely happy with his stay and I deeply thank the host for providing such a comfortable stay. Highly recommended
The place is just as described - cosy rooms.

Il soggiorno è stato molto piacevole, la camera era pulita e spaziosa. Il quartiere è ricco di locali per mangiare vicinissimo alla stazione della metro in piazza taksim. La comunicazione è sempre stata veloce, assolutamente consigliato

description: The location of the house is very close to Bakırköy Square, İncirli Metro and Metrobus.

reviews.text:
This is a hidden gem in the huge amount of the airbnb listings in Istanbul. It's the first proper apartment (instead of hotel suites listed as apartments), privately owned, where my girlfriend and I could really feel at home. It is extremely good value for money, it is conveniently located, 20 minutes far from the airport, less than 10 minutes on foot from the metro, about 10 minutes from the marina, where you can take boats to Eminonu, Kadikoy and Yenikapi (much nicer and often faster than by metro/metrobus). There are also minibuses right next door.
The apartment is quite large, it has a proper kitchen, and it is in a very quiet area. We found it very clean, with nothing needed to be addressed to make our stay more comfortable.
Ilkin was friendly, always replied very quickly, and made sure we had no issues during the entire stay.
We definitely recommend staying here, and we look forward to our next visit.

Great location, very central but still quiet. Metro, Cumhuriyet meydani, port etc. very close. Flat itself is as described, pretty large, with balcony, and provides everything that one might need. Easy check-in and out. Very pet-friendly house and neighborhood.
I can recommend this place.

İlkin hanımın dairesi gerçekten her anlamda harikaydı.Ev rahat,temiz, konforlu, geniş ve ihtiyaç duyulan herşeye sahiptir.Evin konumu çok iyi olduğundan İstanbul'un her noktasına rahatlıkla gezebileceginiz ve alışveriş yapabileceğiniz bir konumdadır ve ulaşım ağlarının çoğuna yürüme mesafesindedir ayrıca Ev sahibi İlkin hanım çok cana yakın bir insan ve en ufak bir sorunda bile bize çok yardımcı oldu.
Ferah, temiz bir daire ve bahsedilen imkanların hepsi mevcuttur. Konum iyi ve merkezi. Anlayışlı ve yardımsever bir ev sahibi, konaklama gayet rahattı, teşekkür ederim.
Big and comfortable flat, the area is quiet and not far from Marmaray station. Also the cleaning was satisfactory.

description: Five min walk away from Nişantaşı 10 min to Taksim , Şişli and Beşiktaş. Close to public transportations ( Metro and Bus Lines ). Please do not care last visitors comment. She was really mad. If you want to really know about me you can read all comments . Thanks 🙏🏻

reviews.text: The place is really good located, the metro station is pretty close and it doesn't take so much time to go the historical center. The room is spacious, clean and the host super nice.

It is with a heavy heart that I write this review. Unfortunately the host refused to respond to me when I let him know the room was too noisy for me to sleep. Literally horns were blowing until after 2:00 in the morning, starting up again by 6, making rest impossible.
This would have been forgivable if not for the fact that I contacted the host before booking and asked specifically about noise, telling him I am a light sleeper and unable to use earplugs. He assured me that at this time of year, with the windows closed, there is no problem. Unfortunately he flat out lied. Then he refused to compensate me at all for the 4 unused nights of my booking.
I would highly recommend you steer clear of this unscrupulous host. There are many quiet and better located options in the wonderful city of Istanbul. And most hosts here are welcoming and accommodating. This was a rare misfortune.
hospitable host, good location (5-7 minutes to osmanbey metro station), excellent internet.
Amazing place to stay. I felt more than welcome and like family. Well situated, so easy to get to and from. I enjoy the neighborhood. The room was very comfortable and I could freely enjoy the flat.

Very cool hosts, you feel at home. If you are planning to visit Istanbul for tourism purposes - a great location, if you have a remote job - everything is available for this. I worked online almost every day, everything was great! The apartment is clean, the hosts are friendly, I recommend! Thank you for this time!

description: Welcome to your modern and cozy home in the heart of Osmanbey! Located in a new building with elevator access, our apartment features fresh furniture, ambient LED lighting, and all essentials for a comfortable stay. Just 100 meters from the metro, you can easily explore Istanbul. Clean sheets and towels are always provided. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text:
Murat was a great host. As he is new on airbnb and there were no comments, so we were reluctant to book his apartment, but when we looked all the details, location, etc. and after a short pre-communication with Murat, we decided to go with it and our decision proved to be 100% correct.
Murat apartment located only 100 m away from osmanbey M2 metro & many buses stops, although it is centrally located but it is really safe & peaceful (no noise), so when we returned in the apartment after spending busy days, we got really relaxed. In my opinion this is much better place for small family with kids than to sultan Ahmed area, which is much busy & always crowded. With metro we reached every place very quickly and without walking too much (kids 8 & 6 years). We stayed about 2 weeks, but we didn’t use taxi even for a single day, as metro & buses connections were pretty good. Even from & to airport we used metro and bus (much faster & cost effective than taxi).
Lot of good restaurants, McDonald, grocery shops were open very late night.
Apartment include all needed amenities for small family. For example we used couple of times washing machine and put the cloths for drying outside at small balcony available in Murat apartment. Air conditioner worked pretty good. Apartment also have small working kitchen, but we didn’t use it, as we ate entirely outside (delicious Turkish food with reasonable cost).
Murat was very communicative and reacted very quickly, there was very minor issue with toilet seat and Murat sent the technician immediately to fix it.. wow for this.
Murat was kind enough that he waited for us more than 1 hour as we arrived late due to flight delay and he let us checkout pretty late, as our flight was late evening. 5 stars for this 
I highly recommend Murat apartment, if I visit again Istanbul I will definitely book again his apartment.
At the end Murat thank you for all and you get all the stars from me *****.
Really near to metro station , and so clean

The curtains should be changed as they let in a lot of light. Also, it's the 6th floor not the 5th floor. We have one child of 7 years old but there balcony key, so it is very dangerous. The place can accommodate 3 people at max(4 if there is a child) more makes it crowded. The host was very friendly and that's a 5 star. The apartment was extremely clean and thats another 5 stars. Not to mention, the apartment was well equipped. However, the power can shut off for a little bit, rarely.Overall a really nice area and a great host, would definitely recommend!
Murat was a nice host, he responded very quickly and his flat was a safe and comfortable for a family

Great and convenient place .. very close to Metro .. Murat is very helpful and responsive.. Really love to stay his place although my travel timing was bad ..
There are lots of superstore and restaurants around the place ..

description: Newly renovated specially designed historical apartment in the heart of Taksim/Beyoğlu. Just 30 meter to İstiklal Street. Clean, secure, well equipped 35m2 (2 rooms) with high ceilings and sunlight. It includes AC, kitchen with refrigerator, washing machine, cooker, microwave, LCD TV, bathroom and all necessary utilities to cook. There is a balcony. There are 1 double bed and 1 sofa that can be convertible to double bed. So with the addition of portable bed 5 guests can be hosted if needed.

reviews.text: Excellent apartment in terms of price/value. Firstly it is very central and close to everything. İstiklal street is just 25 meter away. You can find anything you want there. The apartment is very clean and tidy. It is recently renovated. All the furniture are new and high quality. The sofa is as comfortable as bed. There are 2 rooms and 4 people can comfortably stay in this apartment. Bath is very big and clean. Small kitchen is convenient for cooking but we didn't bother for cooking because the food in restaurants are really nice and extremely cheap. 1 big dish is around 1-2 euro! The host (Erol) is a great guy. ıt is super easy to communicate with him. He is extremely helpful and reachable 7/24. He texted us regularly to check if all is good. Lastly the apartment is shelf check in. We had a very comfortable stay and enjoyed a lot. We highly recommend Erol's place. P.S : he has some other apartments in the same location bigger and for more people. So if you are looking for different alternatives just write him. He can help you. Thank you Erol again and again.

Great great great. I really loved this apartment. Excellent experience in terms of many aspects. First very central location. You are in the heart of the city. You can reach everywhere by walk. Many restaurants and shops are round. We enjoyed all of them. The apartment was very clean and all furniture were new and high quality. 2 rooms big enough to accomodate 4 people. Double bed and sofa were very comfortable to sleep. Last but not least host is very friendly and ready to help in any minute. The price is very good versus what I got in return. Actually everything around was very cheap but high quality (i.e foods, restaurants, shopping). I really loved Beyoğlu area and this apartment. As family of four we really enjoyed our long stay here. Thank you Erol for being great host. I highly recommend you to my friends. We will come again

I found this apartment excellent. I stayed in many places in İstanbul and this was the best one by far. First of all it was very central just 20 meter to İstiklal Street and few minutes to Taksim Square and all transportation facilities. Many good restaurants and shops around. The apartment was great in terms of price - value ratio. 2 rooms big enough for 4 people. Bath and small kitchen was very convenient with all you need. It was furnished very well with very quality and modern furniture. All is very well thought. Everywhere was very clean even though building was historical. The apartment is well restored. The host was great. He was very quick in responding and ready to help for everything. He was really great guy. He gave us a lot of tips and tricks for everything. I highly recommend this apartment to everyone who wants to be in the city center. We enjoyed a lot without any issue. Host also showed where the apartment is in the map. This is very nice of him for you to know where you will exactly.

The location is great and the apartment was clean. I saw a review that mentioned bedbugs so the first thing I did was strip the bed and inspect the mattress. It was new and there is no evidence of any pests, though there was evidence of pests in the past (insect feces present on smoke detector). The purple sofa has been replaced by the red one which is super comfy. The supplies in the kitchen were not really sufficient; anything there was left behind by previous guests. Pots and pans were disgusting. Erol was very communicative but there were a lot of small problems. When we arrived there was a huge leak in the bathroom. That and the tap in the bathroom had to be fixed so we had to stay home during the day to wait for the repairman. Then the washing machine didn't work and we were allowed to use the machine in the apartment downstairs, but then the apartment was rented and we were without a washing machine for the weekend when we wanted to do laundry. Ironing board not really usable (I switched it with the other apartment). Erol was very polite and sent someone to fix the issues but frankly it was really annoying to have all of these minor issues. The hair dryer in the apartment was amazing, though.

A great value for money! Erol has been super nice, welcoming and flexible, helping store our luggage both before check-in (as we arrived early morning) and after check-out. The apartment was clean and cozy, the only two minor drawbacks were the sometimes poor WiFi and the noise from the bars below audible until 2-3 AM with windows closed. Nevertheless, we had a great experience in Istanbul being hosted by Erol and would definitely recommend the place.

description: We combine the Boutique Hotel concept with a friendly and sincere attitude and provide the best service possible to our guests. First of all, we prioritize the satisfaction of our guests. We will be happy to host you.

reviews.text: bu otelin her odası aynı değil. bize verilen oda fotoğraftaki değildi. banyo tuvalet çok dardı aşırı küçüktü. onun dışında resepsiyondaki hanımefendi güler yüzlü ve yardımseverdi. bir kaç konuda sadece iletişime geçtik ve sorunsuz yardımcı oldu halletti. otelin konumu vs çok iyi,ilgi alaka da iyi ama dediğim gibi her odası güzel değil daha geniş bi oda seçerseniz fiyatına göre gayet iyi bir yer.
Bina ve oda çok tatlı ve temiz, personel çok ilgiliydi. İhtiyaçlarıma hemen cevap verdiler. Dışarısı çok soğuk olmasına rağmen geldiğimde oda sıcacıktı. Çok rahat ettim kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.
Sorunsuz bir konaklamaydı. Toplu taşımaya çok yakındı, ulaşım çok kolaydı. Aynı muhitte işim olduğu zaman tekrar tercih ederim.
İçerisi gayet temiz ve fotoğraflardaki gibi güzeldi. En ucuz oda olmasına rağmen her şey yeterliydi.
Konum olarak güzel bir yerde. Ancak giriş ve çıkış saati konusu gerçekten hayal kırıklığı. Bunun dışında odada ikram zayıf ve banyodaki havlular temiz değildi.

description: The flat is closed to Galata Tower which is one of the most famous historical landmarks of Istanbul. It is in the intersection of local and other touristical areas also 5 minutes away from metro and bus stations where you can also hail a cap. There are many boutique cafes around where you can have coffee - breakfast and also supermarket arround. I bet you will arore the rooftop with breathtaking view is accessible for you to take your breakfast or grab a drink at nights.

reviews.text:
This place was comfortable and in an absolutely perfect location, with a great private balcony and a large shared rooftop that has some of the best views of Istanbul. We were comfortable and happy with our stay overall, and Akif was a kind host.
That being said, a few things prevented me from giving higher stars, unfortunately. The walls are really dirty, which made it feel uncomfortable sleeping so close to them in the bedroom. The TV did not work at all, which felt a bit misleading because the photos of the flat include a large TV that we even bought an HDMI cord for that the host’s brother who greeted us recommended we do. Not being able to use the TV in the living room made it a bit uncomfortable overall.
But the AC worked great, the location was amazing, and the place has a washer and dryer, so I’m conflicted on giving 3 stars - wish I could give 5 because it was a sweet flat. With those two issues cleared, it would easily be 5. Thank you Akif!

Mr. Akif's place is located in strategic location: 5 minute walk to Galata Tower, 2 minute walk to bagicilar (i know i spelled wrong) tram station, 8 minute walk to the port of karakoy and easy walk towards to Istical Caddesi (about 6 minute walk). also his place is artists like street (kinda like very mini balat area), and is trendy neighbor hood. also the neighborhood has everything one needs near by; restaurants, grocery & vegitable store, cafe, Gym (cleanest and best gym around the istical should a traveler needs their daily work out)
Due to a bad weather I was not able to check in first day, but Mr. Akif had been very patient and accomodating and assisted me in everyway and even was very flexible. Mr. Akif is highly recommended host to traveler who seeks to find place to stay in istanbul.
Mr. Akif's apartment is very cosy apartment and has one of great roof top terrace and balcony and would be a picturesque worthy (but too bad i came in cold weather days). Thus when it is high season, i recommend to book Mr. Akif's place before it is reserved (yes it can be easily taken by other travelers during spring to fall seasons) by other eager travelers.

It was a pleasure staying at Akif’s apartment. The place was clean, cozy, and very comfortable. We especially enjoyed the private balcony and the shared rooftop terrace. Akif was always quick to respond and provided clear instructions. The self check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free.
The apartment was exactly as described, and everything we needed was provided. The location is very convenient, with the Bosphorus nearby, as well as a popular tourist street and several great places to enjoy delicious food within walking distance.
I would definitely stay here again when visiting the area and would highly recommend it to other guests.

Great apartment, great location with lots of restos and bars close to the apt and with public transport nearby to get to the center. With closed windows the place is well isolated from street noise. The staircase is narrow so you can expect transporting up and down a stroller every day if you come with a baby, but that’s just normal in this neighborhood. Worth noting that there is no door between the living room and the bedroom. Fazil is a great host, very responsive and trying to help as much as he can to make your stay comfortable.

Perfect stay, very comfortable. One of the few streets in Istanbul with green trees in December. The street is a bit busy in the morning and during the day, but it's quiet compared to crowded streets, and you can barely find anything much calmer in Istanbul. The flat is 5 minutes away from a tram station and about 8-10 mins from the metro. Galata tower and nice Turkish restaurants and coffee shops are all over the place.
The flat itself is as described. WiFi connection was decent. The hosts were kind and gave great restaurant recommendations. The shared terrace is available until midnight, I visited it every day and have never encountered anyone.

description: Stay in the heart of historic Sultanahmet, within walking distance of Istanbul’s major attractions. This approximately 40 m² accommodation features 1 bedroom and 1 living room. It includes a private bathroom, microwave, refrigerator, kettle, and dining table with chairs. There is no separate kitchen. Both rooms have air conditioning. The tram station is 1 min away, Hagia Sophia and Basilica Cistern 2–3 min, Blue Mosque 3–4 min, and Topkapi Palace and Grand Bazaar about 5 min on foot.

reviews.text: The apartment is amazing! It’s spacious, clean, and decorated like in the photos. The host also thoughtfully provided shampoo and soap, which was a nice touch. The apartment is at a very convenient location, the Sultanahmet tram station and the Hagia Sofia are only a few minutes walking distance away. There are also plenty of cool bars and restaurants within walking distance, and a convenience store is a few minutes away too. Erdal, the host's communication is excellent as well, he is friendly and responsive. He also offered several useful and helpful recommendations on what to do, eat in the city and how to go to the other zones of the city. Overall i really enjoyed my stay here, and I would recommend other travellers to stay here as well.

Το δωμάτιο είναι ακριβώς όπως στις φωτογραφίες (και μάλιστα καλύτερο). Αποτελείται από ένα δωμάτιο με διπλό κρεβάτι και ένα σαλονάκι με ένα διθέσιο καναπέ που γίνεται διπλό κρεβάτι και έναν μονοθέσιο που γίνεται μόνο κρεβάτι. Το μπάνιο -αν και σχετικά μικρό- πολύ βολικό και με όλα τα κομφόρ! Έχει επίσης τηλεόραση, ψυγειάκι και δύο ντουλάπες.
Το σπίτι βρίσκεται σε απίστευτα κεντρικό σημείο (στο στενό δίπλα στη στάση Sultanahmet της γραμμής T1 του τραμ). Μπορείς να πας στα περισσότερα τουριστικά μέρη με τα πόδια σε μόλις λίγα λεπτά ή πάρεις τη συγκοινωνία και να πας οπουδήποτε!
Ο Erdal είναι ένας υπέροχος άνθρωπος, πρόσχαρος, ευγενικός και πολύ βοηθητικός. Αν και η ώρα του chech in μας ήταν στις 14:00 το μεσημέρι, φτάσαμε αρκετά νωρίτερα και ήρθε να μας βοήθησει με τα πράγματα και να μας δώσει το δωμάτιο από το πρωί. Τη μέρα που φεύγαμε προσφέρθηκε να κρατήσει τις αποσκευές μας μέχρι το βράδυ και λόγω δυσκολίας επικοινωνίας, μας περίμενε ο ίδιος μέχρι το βράδυ για να μας εξυπηρετήσει. Συστήνω ανεπιφύλακτα τη διαμονή στο συγκεκριμένο κατάλυμα!
Erdal is a great guy, very polite and extremely helpful. Although our check in time was 2 p.m. Erdal offered to come and help us three hours earlier! He also offered to keep our luggages even after our check out so that we wouldn't have to carry them all over Istanbul.
The place is just as in the photos and even better! It was sparkling clean and very modern. It's location is everything a tourist could ask. It is really close to the tram station Sultanahmet (T1 line) and you can visit most of the places on foot within a few minutes. I highly recommend staying at this accommodation!
Erdal thank for everything! We will definitely come again!
Erdal was an excellent host, good communication and readily available at the property. Place was cleaned daily and as advertised, great location and not too noisy given it's central location.

4 kişilik aile olarak 4 gece konakladık. Mekan sultanahmet bölgesine ve tramvay durağına çok yakın. Erdal bey ve kardeşi her daim güleryüzlü, çözüm odaklı olarak bizi ağırladı. Kaldığımız 4 gün boyunca hergün dairemiz temizlendi. Misafirperverlikleri için kendilerine teşekkür ederim
Great location. A little bit hard to find the first time. Host is very responsive.

description:
Our apartment is located on the ground (garden) floor of a detached house and has a private entrance, offering guests comfort and independence.
There is open parking available in the garden area.
The property is centrally located and within walking distance to banks, supermarkets, public transportation, shopping areas, and ferry access to the islands. It is also close to the seaside promenade, making it ideal for walking, jogging, and enjoying the coastal atmosphere.

reviews.text:
Before travelling, Fulya told me I could cancel with a full refund as she thought I might not be satisfied because the apartment is old. I explained that being old is not a problem as long as a place is clean and comfortable. Unfortunately, while the apartment is in a lovely old building, a good size and great location, it felt far from comfortable due to several maintenance issues.
The kitchen cupboard door hits the ceiling light, the microwave setup was awkward, the garden was overgrown, and the washing machine started when the door was not properly shut, causing water to leak everywhere. The hoover was also unusable, there was a damp smell and peeling paint, broken drawers, a broken clothes horse with exposed screws that ripped my top, and a broken chair in the entrance.
With some maintenance and small improvements, this could be a lovely place. Before leaving, I mentioned the issues to Fulya’s mum and sister, who were very kind, apologetic, and said they would address the problem.

A deceptive listing. The photos look amazing but everything in the property is of a poor poor quality. The bedding was horrendous. No AC, no Fan. It was soo warm in Turkey whilst we visited. The Bathroom had the most horrible smell from the bathroom which the host wasn't able to fix. I would not stay here again despite it being a nice sized apartment.

Fulya's place is beautiful, well decorated and clean. It is in a very central location and close to lots of amenities in including shopping stores. bus stops, restaurants and coastal walk. Fulya was an absolutely amazing host. She was quick to response, very resourceful, and pleasant to be around. We were more than grateful we were able to stay at her place.

Öncelikle ev sahibi çok misafirperverdi. Eve varana kadar iletişim konusunda sıkıntı yaşamadık.Eve girdikten sonra tüm ihtiyaçlarımiz hakkında iletişim kurabileceğimizi belirti ve ihtiyaçlarımıza dönüş sağladı.Evin konumu çok iyi.Metroya,Marmaraya,hızlı trene ve bostancı vapur iskelesine yürüme mesafesinde.Bir alt sokağında işlek bir cadde bulunuyor.Her türlü ihtiyaçlarınızı buradan karşılayabilirsiniz.Çok çeşitli dükkanlar, restoranlar ve kafeler mevcut.Evin olduğu sokak sakin ve sessizdi.Ancak eve gelecek olursak malesef hayal kırıklığı yaşadık.Sanırım fotoların bazıları çok eski.Ev kesinlikle tadilat istiyor.Evde girer girmez çok ağır bir nem/rutubet kokusu mevcuttu.Akan tavanlar vardi.Duvarlar hep kirliydi.Eşyalar çok eski ve yıpranmıştı.Evde böcek,karınca özellikle örümcek vardı.Duvarlarda örümcek ağları vardı.Hatta bardağın içindede.Bahçe katı olması sebep ama ilaçlama yapılabilir.Bazı peteklerin altı örümcek ağı kaplamıştı.Potansiyeli yüksek,ev elden geçirilirse muhteşem olur:(

it would be better if the apartment was at least vacuumed. the pillowcases were with someone's hair, there was black long hair on the floor. ironing board without cover. iron can kill you, bare wires. otherwise everything was fine. Big thank you for fixing WiFi and helping us to find laboratory for pcr test! Fulya is good host, but not great, just she need to work a bit and all will be perfect. Thank you again.

description:
Antoine Galata is located in the 160 year old Grade II Listed Urgliavich Building next to the Galata Tower.
The building was fully renovated in 2012. All apartments are luxuriously refurbished with top-of-the-line amenities.
Galata Neighbourhood is where the heart of the City beats with some of the best restaurants and cafés in town very conveniently located.
Shopping for daily amenities, souvenirs and other needs is very easy and safe in the neighbourhood.
Location is extremely central.

reviews.text: This property is relatively expensive compared to other listings on Airbnb. However, it’s justified through great location, well communicated and helpful host and the most important thing is, the unit is clean and as what you seen in photos - pretty layout. Worth the money. Definitely will book again in the future (if they are available).

Naz’s flat is absolutely stunning and in a great location for exploring Istanbul!
Absolutely stunning - The flat is exactly as shown in the pictures, but the views were even better than expected! Everything was clean and very comfortable.
Great location - We loved staying in the “New” side of the city! We felt the evening food and nightlife options were superior in the Galata/Pera/Karakoy area. From the flat to major sites on the historic side was about a 45 minute walk, but there are plenty of public transportation options. There is also a lot to see and do on the way so we walked everywhere.
Naz was a wonderful host. She greeted us and provided us with so many great recommendations. She was a very kind and attentive host.
One thing I will note, the flat is above a popular cafe that is open late. My husband slept through any noise, but for my fellow light sleepers - I recommend some earplugs. The cafe does have fabulous San Sebastián cheesecake though, so be sure to check it out!

Majestic Galata Apt with the best views of Galata Tower that only a handful of properties can claim to provide in Istanbul, this historical Urgliavich Apt & Bldg built in 1867 probably has the best unobstructed views available of Galata Tower along with a panoramic view from the common roof terrace but in only 3 Apts in bldg to share, you always find private moments to enjoy the views of most of Istanbul. 1 bed Apt with balcony is best on 2nd floor, Renovated in 2013 bldg has a private entrance, elevator access to all floors & is at the doorstep of Galata Tower. Shops, stores, restaurants, street food, pharmacy all around. Naz is an exceptional host, arranged for our seamless pick up and drop to Airport at a good price. Great detailing, sparkling clean, insulated windows keeps the noise out, excellent amenities, Uber accessible, Guney cafe, Saltbae Galata at doorstep. 10-15mins to Taksim, if you are looking for a luxurious & comfortable stay in the heart of Galata, then THIS IS IT!!!

We had a fabulous stay. The apartment is comfortable and airy and as beautiful as the photos. We made use of the kitchen for breakfasts and some dinners. The terrace off the apartment is a great space to take in the activity of the neighborhood with morning coffee. The terrace on the 5th floor is a great place to take in the sunset and have cocktails. We loved the Galata neighborhood and it's proximity to Taksim, Istanbul Modern and the Old City. Naz is very responsive and answered any questions we had. Definitely a great chapter in our Istanbul experience and we would definitely stay again.

Naz was an exceptional host—consistently attentive, accommodating with scheduling, and generous in offering thoughtful suggestions..
The apartment was exactly as depicted in the photos—truly wonderful. It was tastefully decorated in a classic style, with meticulous attention to detail, and was impeccably clean and well-organized.
Everything one might need was readily available.
The location was perfect—beyond perfect, in fact.
We absolutely loved Istanbul and sincerely hope to return soon.
Thank you !!

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Sultanahmet Apart & Suites: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Sultanahmet is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, our mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text: A great place to stay in an excellent area. Easy walking distance to the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, many restaurants, shopping and all the tourist sites in the Sultanahmet area. Comfortable and clean. 3 floors up an spiral staircase, but the host was able to help us with our luggage.

Great location. Wonderful welcome. Both bedrooms were super…. But we thought we were getting a two room apartment… but actually two separate rooms adjacent in a small hotel. That was a surprise but not a problem. I definitely would not bother with booking chauffeur service … that was a waste of time both waiting at the airport and waiting to depart… the service was expensive and slow. Much better to take a taxi or uber. Other than that the apartment was great and the location so easy and accessible to mosques, bazaar and cistern. A wonderful stay. Many thanks.

Lovely accommodation, fabulous location, beautiful rooms. Perfect for us travelling with an adult child who had a completely separate unit on the same floor. Great contact, very helpful and so flexible. We are definitely planning to stay again very soon. Be aware there a lot of stairs less mobile might find that difficult. Excellent value. Bring a towel if you are curvy 🫣 - thank you for a comfortable stay and being so accommodating

We loved our stay here. So easy to walk to Sultanahmet Square and other important locations. Plenty of restaurants nearby. Comfortable beds, lovely views to the water and lots of room for us to store our belongings. Ercan was so helpful to organise an additional night stay and for us to switch apartments easily. The transfer he arranged to the airport after our early morning departure was on time and made it easy for us. Would stay here again and recommend for anyone wanting a well located stay in Istanbul.

Ecran was very responsive and met us at the apartment when we arrived. We had two rooms which connected each with their own bathroom. Both king beds were comfortable. We only stayed one night but wish we would have stayed longer. The location was incredible. Walking to the main sights in Istanbul took us 5-10 minutes. The neighborhood had many cute shops and a small bazaar nearby. I would definitely recommend staying here. Keep in mind that the two rooms are on the top floor without an elevator.

description:
This charming apartment is perfectly decorated for a cozy and comfy stay.

The apt also includes a private balcony as well as access to the shared terrace, which offers stunning views in all directions.

the location is just pleasant to discover the town and the city.

The apartment is outfitted with new appliances , WiFi and air conditioning. This is a cozy and inspiring place to be . We look forward to hosting you at the heart of the city

reviews.text:
First of all, Ali and Eyp are super friendly and helpful! Eyp even did the check in for me and showed me all the details rather than leaving me a key like most of the Airbnb. And he also gave me amazing tips for İstanbul and shopping. And Ali helped over the phone with many things.You really feel the warm of the host.
Secondly, the apartment is very nice decorated and you can find everything you need including kitchen utensils, shower gel n shampoo, washing machine and two sets of clean towels. It’s really much better than the photos, plus that you have an amazing view of the city and Galata tower and rooftop, so it’s pretty spacious.
Last but not least, it’s 5min walk to Taksim where the shopping street is, also 5min to historical Galata tower, although there are fantastic cafe downstairs , supermarket and pharmacy so you barely need to worry about anything. And if you walk 2 min to Tophane tram station, you will reach the Blue Mosque in 5min! (2 station)
I wish I could have stayed longer!

Eyp welcomed our early check in, while he wasn’t available at the time, his father was and welcomed us nicely. He also checked on us the day after we checked in if we needed anything and assured us they’re available in case we need anything, as something small as a toilet paper or an extra towel to any fixes required.
The view from the wide window, the balcony and the rooftop are the cherry on top.
There is one AC unit above the bed, which is fine for such a space, we didn’t feel we needed extra cooling system.
The place is definitely located in a great location, close to coffee shops and shops, and the fun Karakoy alleys. A short walking distance from the Main Street, metro, bus and Karakoy ferry stations that takes you to the Asian side, and also the Galata street.
The place is gorgeous, good sunlight in the sofa area, and the space matched the photos, however a tiny one. The bathroom is really small, and overall space is also considerably small. The place is located on the fourth floor with no elevator, and a small spiral staircase, it was okay with us, maybe a bit of a trouble if you have large luggage, but if worked for us, would work for anyone I guess :) - so If you don’t mind this, definitely book here and enjoy your stay!

Perfectly located! Lots of cute cages and restraunts, very close to tram that takes you to Sultanhamet and also a short walk to Galata Tower. The stairs are a lot but worth it in my mind. AC and washing machine worked great. Mattress was okay. The deck is on the roof and the WiFi does not reach there.

we enjoyed our stay at Eyo’s apartment. it was located in a great area close to all main attractions and tourist spots. the apartment itself was what you’d expect staying in the older city but was a bit smaller than we was expecting and also a bit on the colder side at night but this was due to the temperature drop off. Lastly I cannot fault Eyo and Ali as hosts, they were always quick to respond with any queries or issues. Our flight was in the evening on our last day but Eyo let us leave our luggage at his father’s house a 2 minute walk away after check out so that we could still enjoy our day. Overall, it was a good apartment for the price we paid and both hosts were great.
We stayed there for 5 nights, and it was a nice stay. It is located nicely, close to all the historical places in Istanbul. The flat was clean, as described, and the owners were very responsive.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located pet friendly place. The apartment is in a safe and peaceful area. You can enjoy the cinema with smart tv supported projection. There is central heating&ac. Lovely,sunny, spacious, bright, large apartment. Across the building, there is a park surrounded by greenery where you can do sports. There is private parking. Bağdat Street is within walking distance. 5 minutes walking distance to public transport, stops, pharmacies, hospitals and cafes.

reviews.text: Absolutely perfect place to stay! I don’t know where to start, since this is our seventh time in Istanbul, and somehow we decided to stay for a month and try to live a regular life here since during the years we have visited probably 99% of the attractions and tourist places. The initial and all further communication with Plui went great, and between my first question until reservation (and I had not only one question) passed less than an hour. Plui sent us all explanations and instructions in video format and by following it finding a place or using drying or washing machine in Turkish became a piece of cake. The apartment itself is on the top floor with windows everywhere, perfectly clean, decorated with a lot of style and attention to detail. Bed is very comfortable with sockets and night tables, balcony is ideal for having a good morning coffee, but kitchen is my favorite. Since cooking is my task, Plui’s, at first glance small, kitchen is very well equipped and it will save you a great amount of time while preparing your meal. You’ll find everything, from small cups for coffee to huge food processors, and filter coffee machine (the king of every morning ritual). In the evening enjoying Netflix is way easier with projector mounted in the living room, and really good quality stereo system will allow you to play good music during the day. If judging from the Google maps the place seems a bit far but with two metro lines and Marmaray train nearby, reaching any place in the city is really easy. Because of the location you will enjoy in the quiet apartment where you will have a hard time to wake up in the morning during the weekend. Altogether, for now the best place we stayed in Istanbul and I can only hope we’ll get a chance to come again.

my stay at Plui's apartment was lovely. it was spacious, clean and comfortable. though the Air conditioning was not functioning, the apartment is on the top floor and thus is adequately ventilated with open windows and a fan running (the windows have insect nets, which is great).
Everything you could need is available, towels were even provided, But the Projector and Coffee machine are a great bonus☺️ the apartment is located in a quiet area, which is close, but not next to, public transport such as the Marmaray and metro.
Plui was available via phone if there was any problems, but I faced none. Check-in was self done, though videos of how to use the appliances etc. were provided, nice to refer back to!
I'd love to stay again, thank you Plui!

We stayed at Plui’s apartment for one month and had a truly wonderful experience.
The location is excellent, in a beautiful and pleasant neighborhood. Transportation is very convenient, and there are several supermarkets within about a five-minute walk, which made daily life very easy.
The apartment is modern, comfortable, and fully equipped. The building has two elevators, which is very convenient for a longer stay. Plui also has excellent taste and a very high standard for beauty, furniture, and interior design. The apartment is beautifully decorated, and staying in such a lovely home every day gave us a lot of positive and peaceful energy.
People in the neighborhood were very friendly and welcoming. Plui was also very caring, helpful, and supportive throughout our stay.
Istanbul is truly a beautiful city full of culture and kind people. We highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable long stay in Istanbul.
Thank you again, Plui!

First of all, Plui is really nice and helpful host. Before entering the house, she shared informative visuals about the house and how to use the electronics in the house. The check in process was smooth. We stayed in Plui's house for 1 week. The location of the house is 15 minutes walking distance to goztepe marmaray. It’s also close to bus stops. The location is central but at the same time quiet and peaceful. The house is also very suitable for long term stays, it will meet your every need comfortably. We are very happy to stay in this clean, comfortable and peaceful house. You can choose with peace of mind.

Was a great option for my week in Istanbul. Quiet residential area. Spacious apartment with nice kitchen and main foyer. Hot water and Wi-Fi were good. Elevator in building was fine. Communication and self check in was fine.

description:
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

2 minutes to city’s nişantaşı mall
10 minutes to metro station
Cafes restaurants super markets are 1 minute distance

reviews.text: Evin her tarafı çatlaklarla doluydu . Duvarlar kirden siyahlaşmıştı . Buzdolabının içi rezaletti . Ekstra koydukları yatak lekelerle doluydu . Kapının kilidi bozuktu . Havalandırma bozuldu ev sahibiyle iletişime geçmeye çalıştık ama bize cevap vermedi . Klimalar çalışmıyordu . Tuvalet kağıdı , havlu , tek kullanımlık terlik , sabun duş jeli vs yoktu . Yerler pisti . 2 yatak vardı ve yataklar rezalet derecede kirliydi . Çarşafların üstünde kıl vardı . Bu ev sadece konumu için var yoksa evde değil köpek kulübesinde kalsanız daha rahat edersiniz . Mutfak Tezgah üstünde tost makinesi kirden ve pas’tan kullanılamaz haldeydi . Duş başlığı bozuktu . Parasını ödediğimiz için mecburen oturduk çünkü para iadesi yoktu yanımızda bakıma muhtaç hasta vardı .

Logement pour 3 personnes (un couple et un enfant).
Ali et ses co-partenaires sont toujours réactifs, vous avez une question ou un problème, ils sont toujours présents pour vous répondre et arranger le problème.
Le logement est bien situé, est spacieux, la literie est bonne, l'espace douche aussi rien à redire.
Comme nous l'avons exprimé à Ali lors du séjour, le problème a été l'hygiène notamment des draps à l'arrivée, du canapé et du tapis dans le salon.
De plus pour le prix je trouve que la prestation n'est pas à la hauteur, ce sont des détails pour certains mais nous payons ces détails. La lampe dans le salon ne fonctionne pas, la lumière de la hotte non plus, il manque le matériel de base pour la cuisine, nous avons dû acheter de l'huile, du sel, du poivre. Les équipements n'étaient pas très propres ( assiettes etc), il manque du matériel pour faire à manger. La machine à laver est un plus.
Nous n'avons pas testé le lave vaisselle.
Ev gayet temizdi insana kendi evindeymiş gibi hissettiriyordu, ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi, herkese tavsiye ederim

We had some problems, and Ali was always there and helped us a lot. The apartment had an amazing location. Everything around it was restaurants, pharmacies, clothing stores, and even a salon. From a safety standpoint, the door to the building is locked and no one can enter without a key.
Deservs irs price.

description: Escape to our modern, family-friendly apartment in a historic Istanbul Old City building. This calm retreat comfortably sleeps 5 and offers a stunning rooftop sea view. Perfectly located for exploring iconic landmarks on foot, it's an ideal base for your adventure. Features include Wi-Fi, A/C, and a kitchenette. Note: 5th-floor walk-up, no elevator.

reviews.text:
Zefer and his brother are really nice, relabel and helpful . And the location is amazing(more traditional), very clean (100% like the photos), strong WiFi, easy access to different places in Istanbul, and last but not least is has a wonderful balcony.
Like most of the apartments in Istanbul is has no elevator.
All in all Zefer as an very good host and it was a great place to stay in my first travel to istanbul.

We had a great time at Zafer’s apartment! We arrived very late and he was there, waiting for us, made us coffee when we came and we felt like home, after a long trip.
The apartment looks exactly like in the photos. It is located on the fifth floor (Zafer helped us with our bags) and considering it is the last floor, you have a big balcony with a great view of Istanbul. It was therapeutic to sit there, and chill. Especially by night. There is a table and chairs, also.
The apartment had everything. Washing machine, air conditioning, hairdryer, iron - everything was there. It is very clean, spacious and comfortable.
The neighborhood is ok, the first mini markets are nearby, few steps from the apartment. Also, restaurants, bakeries - it had everything you need.
I would recommend Zafer’s place to everyone that prefer upper floors, with a dose of privacy and big balcony with a view and I would choose this accommodation again, when I visit Istanbul again.
Thank you, Zafer!

A nice apartment. Though may seem quite small, but we comfortably stayed there for 2 nights as a family with 2 adults and 3 children (2 teens and 1 pre-school) thanks to good space usage. It has a big private terrace/roof with a Bosphorus view, with a BBQ stuff, though we didn't use it as it was quite cold and windy there already, in the October.
A manager that checked us in was extremely helpful and friendly. He also provided us a parking place just near the apartment.
! Be aware that the apartment is on the 4th floor by a quite narrow spiral staircase, and there's no elevator.
Overall, good value for money.

Really loved this apartment, the view is stunning in the morning when you wake up you have a beautiful seaview. The apartment is nice and modern looking yet still felt very cozy. The host was very kind and helpful and responded quickly. Check-in was super easy which was nice after an exhausting trip. Alot of the main attractions in Sultanahmet are still within walkable distance yet it was nice to come retreat in such a comfortable apartment. I would look for an apartment exactly like this if I were to have a long stay in Istanbul.

Really enjoyed our stay at this place. It was clean and packed with toiletries. The host was very friendly and helpful. The only two downsides are that the neighborhood doesn’t feel very safe to walk in at night and the stairs that you have to take everyday to get to the apartment.

description: Very clean and fully equipped flat in Beyoğlu near to İstiklal street at the very heart and center of Istanbul. There are so many options for entertainment and cultural experiences nearby (museums, theaters, cinemas, bars, restaurants, coffee houses), shopping, mosques, churches, historical places, universities, palaces, antique shops. It's also close to Taksim metro and tophane tram stations, and just two minutes to Istiklal street.

reviews.text:
Nurten has perfect personality. She’ll help with everything and will respond right away. The window Curtain broke she fix it right away.
I Supposed to check in at 1 PM. My flight was delayed eight hours she waited in the apartments all of that time.
The location of the apartment is in a nice, close to Taksim square, but noisy a little bit. There’s always work’s going on in the building, makes hard to sleep during morning time.
The bed needs new mattress.
Lack of cleaning supplies, Shampoo, soaps toilet paper, washing machine Detergent, dishwasher detergent.
And most important things is instructions. Since everything’s in Turkish language.
I was advised by Nurten not to drink Tap water, it wouldn’t hurt to leave a bottle or 2 of water as welcoming plus tea and coffee, till guests be familiar with the area. Not that expensive.
Other then that everything’s was perfect. We enjoyed our vacation in Turkey.

You will never ever find a host better than Nurten. She was so friendly, kind, responsive and awesome. She was perfect.
Not only she was our host for 15 nights but also she was a guide for our trip. She answered all my questions in less than 10 minutes each time. She was 100/100. She helped me find places and gave me a lot of suggestions as well.
The house was awesome too. You will find everything you need in the house. Is completely suitable for 4 people. Two couch in the living room was big enough for 2 adults. AC worked well. All kitchen stuff was perfect. It would be better to have more pots and pans and more detergent but overall all was perfect.
Bathroom, toilet, bedroom, living room, kitchen all were clean and good. We had hot water for bathroom.
The location of the house was perfect. It is 2 minutes walk to the middle of Istiklal street but the neighborhood was kind of noisy and you need to close the window if you are sensitive to noise when sleeping.
All in all, 100/100

Nurten has two 1 bedroom apartments adjacent to each other in an ideal location an easy 5-10 minute (flat) walk to Taksim, right off of Istiklal near Cihangir (which is more hilly). This one has a smaller bedroom/bed with a small balcony, and the other has a slightly larger bedroom/bed without a balcony. The apartment was very comfortable and we had no issues with the internet while my partner worked remotely. Nurten is also a lovely host and welcomed us on arrival.

It’s a really nice comfortable flat in the centre of Istanbul with all the attractions really close. The flat is really clean and is actually better than the photos in the description. You cannot get a better location in Istanbul. Nurlan is really helpful about things to do in the area and is always on hand and responds quickly if you have any queries. I cannot recommend this flat enough.

Nurten, is the best host that you can meet, she is very welcoming, waited for us in the apartment and showed us the house and guided us on how to use appliances. clean bed sheet and towels were waiting for us.
Location is 2 min walk from Istiklal Str., restaurants and various shops.
she is very responsive during our stay. she speaks english, recommended listing.

description:
Stylish and modern living space in Nişantaşı, the heart of Istanbul. This centrally located house is very close to City's Shopping Mall. You will feel as peaceful as at home in the most prestigious area of Istanbul.
Bright and spacious apartment with 2 bedrooms.

reviews.text: very good location. apartment as described. comfortable. very responsive host - give us exact instructions, recommendations and helped with our needs. 2 things to keep in mind - it's on 4th floor w/o lift, internet speed is as usual in Turkiye. overall - highly recommended.

I initially didn’t believe in the two negative reviews, as most feedback was positive—but they turned out to be accurate. Lights on one floor of the apartment were not working, and there were visible stains on the bed sheets, windows, and curtains, one of the chairs was broken and one of the paintings was also damaged. While Dilan is very responsive and attentive, there seems to be a lack of attention to the cleanliness of the apartment, which was disappointing. The location is convenient, with a paid parking lot nearby (1,000 TL per 24 hours as of May 2025), but beyond that, the stay didn’t meet expectations.

Ev metroya 2 dakika yürüme mesafesindeydi ve fiyatı konumuna göre oldukça uygundu. Ancak genel deneyimimiz çok olumsuzdu.
Check-in bilgilerinde iki farklı daire numarası vardı ve doğru binayı bulmakta zorlandık. Bina eski ve bakımsızdı, temizlik ise yüzeyseldi, yerde büyük toz birikintileri vardı. Check-in saati 16.00 ise daha iyi bir temizlik beklerdik.
En rahatsız edici kısım Dilan Hanım’ın gece 03.40’ta beni arayıp yalnızca “Kapıda bir adam var” demesi oldu. Doğal olarak gece boyu büyük bir korku yaşadım ve uzun süre endişeyle bekledim. Ertesi sabah “Sipariş verdiniz sandım bakın diye aradım” dedi ancak o saatte neden kamerayı kontrol edip bizi bu şekilde uyandırdığını anlayamadık. Üstelik kapının üst kilidi de kırıktı ve kendimizi hiç güvende hissetmedik.
Ertesi gün de çıkış yaptığımızı sanarak eve temizlikçi gönderildi. Genel olarak iletişim, organizasyon ve güven açısından hiç memnun kalmadık.

The apartment is spotless, great location and Dilan so responsive.
The only issue is there is no elevator and the apartment is the 4th floor,
So if you have heavy luggage you will struggle.
In general the apartment so good , clean , location so good and the price is affordable.

Merhaba, konum olarak harika ve iletişim olarak gayet hızlılar teşekkürler fakat temizlik olarak malesef çok hakkını veremedi. Detaylı temizliğe ihtiyac var özellikle yatakların altı çok tozluydu. Klima olmaması da ayrı dir dez avantaj.

description: Hello, our place is specially designed for families and consists of separate beautiful apartments where couples, families with children, families of 3, 4, 5, 6 people can easily stay together. We look forward to hosting our guests. Best regards

reviews.text: Gemakkelijk te bereiken via metro. Behulpzame host. Vriendelijke ontvangst. Goed toegankelijk met een kinderwagen. Grote lift aanwezig

It has a bad smoking smell as we found ashtrays inside the property and the person at the desk was sleeping so we tried waking him up for the first 5 minutes. The properties beds were over used and definitely need to be changed, and the sofas had stains all over it. I guess this property is used for other purposes and is not suitable for a calm stay at night with your friends or family, or if you’re on a road trip.
uygun fiyatlı, metroya yakın, deniz gören evler...
Ev çok rahattı. Tavşantepe metro durağına da çok yakın olduğu için Sabiha Gökçen'e gidecekler için çok avantajlı.
metro ile erişim var... evler uygun temiz ve büyük

description:
Our place is centrally located in Beyoglu which is in the historical area of Istanbul.
The place is 11 min walking distance to Istiklal Street, bars, restaurants. It is also very close to most important historical places such as Eminonu, Sultanahmet, Galata, Grand Bazaar.
The metro and bus stations are 1 km and 450 m away, respectively.
It is located in the residential area. So it is important to be quite after 10 pm.
THIS FLAT MAY NOT BE SUITABLE FOR KIDS UNDER 8 SINCE THE STAIRS ARE STEEP.

reviews.text: The flat was clean and the same as the picture. Big and comfortable beds, Fully-equipped kitchen, and a nice shower. Easy and flexible check-in. The flat has two balconies, a nice one on the top floor with view over the city. Hakan and his staff were very friendly and helpful. They helped us to call a taxi to the airport and carry the bagages up and downstairs. They are available the whole time and answer very fast. The flat is near Istiklal street, 15 minutes walk, and 20 minutes walk to Taksim square. It is located on a hill and you have to go up and down while walking. There is a mosque next to the flat and you hear the call to prayer 5 times a day and it is a little bit annoying specially at 4 a.m in the morning.

We had a very pleasant stay. The accommodation was clean, well laid out and very central. We enjoyed walking to Taksim Square. There were a few kiosks and places to eat nearby. The two balconies with a great view were particularly nice. The beds were comfortable and communication with the host went smoothly. Thank you for letting us check in early :)
A small note: The stairs to the flat are quite steep, so I would recommend the stay to younger or fitter guests. The toilet seat was loose and should be checked. There was also some mould in the shower and on the bathroom ceiling. Perhaps something can be improved here. Overall, however, a nice accommodation with a lot of charm!

Nice place. Close enough to the major attractions. Bus stop a 15min walk away so fairly convenient. Be ready for some climbing though as it’s located in a hilly area! Steep staircase to enter the place which may prove to be a problem for some guests. There is also a mosque right next door which some may find disturbing during prayer hours in the early morning. The WiFi was quite problematic and not reliable. Cigarette smoke also enters from downstairs/the outside through the AC causing the place to smell of cigarettes. The smoke detectors were stuck onto the ceiling and all of them fell during our stay. One almost landing on our head!
However, we enjoyed our stay! The view from the top balcony is quite enjoyable. Hakan & Turkan were very responsive to our questions and requests. They were also kind enough to provide cleaning once during our stay. Overall would recommend!

Stayed here for a couple of nights, liked it and recommend it. Let’s be clear, it is not perfect, but for this price and location, perfect for me, 5 stars. The owner was very friendly, helped me a lot, I have norhing to say negative. The apartment, is spacious, clean. It could benefit for a small renovation, a window in the bathroom, a wall needs a paint, the acces in the apartment which is very small but you cannot modify this, these are things to keep in mind. I would definitely stay here again, again, price is perfect for it. You find hardly a parking space in front, but easy 300m away payed, you have a mosque right in front of the bedroom and at 04 am you will get up because it is really loud, but that is ok for me. +++++

just as described, and they were very flexible with checking in early which we really appreciated. The location is also pretty good, we walked to beyoglu and kadikoy. The staircases are a little narrow inside the building so not suitable for certain people and large luggage.

description:
Stay in a renovated 19th-century Ottoman-era historic apartment, blending timeless charm with modern comfort. Featuring high ceilings, exposed brick walls, and original wooden floors, it offers an authentic stay in the heart of Beyoğlu.

Located just a 6-minute walk from İstiklal Street, you’ll be surrounded by cafés, restaurants, shops, and vibrant city life.

With easy access to metro, bus, and taxi connections, you can easily explore all major attractions across Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The overall impression is good. The apartment is fresh and beautiful, it matches the pictures. It has almost all the necessary details for a comfortable stay, including a dishwasher and laundry detergents. And the host seems very nice.
The location is minutes walking from Istiklal and there is a bus station nearby.
A few drawbacks that you would consider when making a decision are:
The apartment is in historical area and there are no elevators in the houses. And the stairs are very narrow and steep. So it would take some effort to get bulky luggage to the third floor.
Also there is no air conditioning in the apartment, and there is only one fan (as I know the host was ready to get a second one). For the end of June this was hardly enough, also the fan is quite noisy for the nighttime.
Finally, the area is very noisy. We could hear a lot of loud cars sounds, people shouting, and the construction works (even at night). And since there is no air conditioning we kept the windows open.

Our stay in Istanbul at Rayans house was very comfortable. The appartment was very tidy and clean, just like the pictures. The location is near Iskital street and many other important tourist is places, however not so close the blue mosque or Hagia Sofia. It was a bit difficult for us to find the building, because google maps didn’t pin point correctly the location. We arrived late, and were a bit distressed by the neighborhood at night and the narrow stairs of the entrance, but next morning we found it was a very local neighborhood. Just beware there is no elevator, so if you have many heavy things to carry, you would have to do it on your own. Other than that, Rayan is very friendly and the apartment very comfortable! Thanks you so much 🙂🙂

We had a very pleasant and comfortable stay at Rayan’s apartment in Istanbul. Rayan was a very friendly and responsive, even though we didn’t meet him in person. The self check-in was easy and the apartment was really well-equipped, clean and well-designed. The apartment was a bit hard to find with maps but with a little effort, we found it. It is on the third floor with no elevator and narrow stairs, which was fine for us, but one has to carry the bags himself. The location was close to Taksim and had public transport connections. There was also a small shop downstairs for breakfast stuff which was really useful. There was also a really friendly pet cat in the building, which sometimes visited us in the apartment. We mostly took taxis, but sometimes they would drop us far from the apartment, saying they could not go on this street. Make sure the taxi drops you at the door, especially if you have luggage. We would like to thank Rayan for making our stay pleasant.

Great spot in Beyoglu. Exactly as described and very clean. Rayan was friendly and easily contactable.
Comfortable for a family or two couples. Kitchen is fantastic. Washer/dryer is a plus.
The neighborhood (especially to the east) brought a little discomfort, but we warmed up to it quickly. The people are kind, convenient mini-markets nearby.

Rayan was a great host who was friendly and responsive to messages.
The apartment itself is just a short walk from İstiklal Avenue, Taksim Square and the surrounding, bars, cafes, restaurants and nightlife. Galata Tower and the Bosphorus would be around a 30 minute walk, so all quite manageable. Uphill on the way back though. You have been warned!
The apartment we felt looked better than the photographs, was homely and had everything we needed. (our only issue was we could only find two wine glasses to drink from, but it's possible we never found the glasses cupboard!)
As with every trip I packed ear plugs and a sleep mask, and if light and noise pollution is something that you take issue with, I recommend you do the same.
In conclusion we loved staying in Rayan's apartment and we wouldn't hesitate to stay here again on a return trip to Istanbul.

description:
- Pesa Suites offers its guests a comfortable accommodation experience with its stylish and modern design.
- Located in the center of Istanbul, Pesa Suites is within walking distance of the city's historical and entertainment venues.
- There is daily cleaning and 24-hour reception service.

reviews.text:
I really like this area of Istanbul, so I chose this hotel. It was one of the cheapest for my travel dates. I stayed for a couple of days, and the accommodation is very conveniently located for me, with good restaurants, shops, and public transport stops nearby. The accommodation itself is a bit worn out. I was surprised that there was no headboard on the bed, which was not very comfortable. There were only 2 pillows instead of 4 as shown in the photo, so my head touched the wall, which was not very comfortable. The towels had a smell and stains, which really spoiled the impression. But I brought my own just in case. On the last night, noisy men moved into the next room.
There was very fast internet! This was a pleasant surprise and important for me since it was a business trip.
Otherwise, the stay was normal. The receptionist was friendly and welcoming. Thank you for the warm reception. I hope the minor issues will be fixed, and all guests will be 100% satisfied.

I genuinely loved my stay with Erhan at his hotel! he was incredibly friendly, super helpful, he gave us a tips of where to eat (Please please please try out Konatchi Dayim- local kebab house literally 5m away, cheap meats that are the best in Istanbul- way better than the overpriced famous kebab shops)
The hotel itself was really clean, well spaced out, toilets were beautiful and clean, everything worked well-AC and TV, the location is PERFECT! on the "quieter" side of Istanbul and the tram stop is just down the road taking you into the busy touristy sultanahmet area.
When I visit Istanbul again, I am definitely staying at Pesa Suites.

The apartment was clean and exactly as described. The location is very convenient — we mostly got around on foot, which was easy and comfortable. There are plenty of nice restaurants nearby.
As a suggestion, it would be great to have a bit more lighting in the room, as it felt a little dark.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. The host was always available, responsive, and quick to reply. Thank you for the hospitality!

Great location near Galata and the tram, making it easy to get around without steep walks. The unit was functional but a bit dark and small; fine for solo travelers, though bed access could be tight for couples. The main issue was the AC in room 103 struggling to cool the space, but I was moved to a better room. Communication was mostly automated and responses were slow, and the reception desk was unstaffed during posted hours. Overall, the price was reasonable for the accommodation—I’d stay here again.

reviews.text: Great value for the price! The place was clean, ideal for a couple, and conveniently located next to the metro. Zain, the host, was fantastic—swiftly resolving a WiFi issue we encountered. Highly recommended for a comfortable stay

The apartment was clean and well equipped. Zain responded quickly and provided clear instructions for the check-in process.
We did miss having air conditioning in the bedroom – the unit in the living room had to work hard to cool down the entire apartment.
The main reason we booked this apartment was the large terrace shown in the photos. However, contrary to the pictures, the apartment does not have a private terrace. There's only a shared rooftop terrace, which looks nothing like the one in the photos. It's dirty and full of bird droppings. According to Zain, nobody uses it.

The apartment has one bedroom, a kitchen, and a bathroom, with all necessary appliances including a stove, sink, washing machine, and fridge. It is suitable for two people, clean, and the bedroom faces the street, but the area is quiet at night. The only downside was a power outage for over an hour, which seems common in the area. The neighborhood has all necessary shops, and the bus/metro station is less than 5 minutes away. The owner was very responsive.

This is a good option in case of the price/performance balance. It's located in an old and historic area of ​​Istanbul. The home is also in an area that receives migration, but there is no security problem. It’s close to the metro station, and offers a better experience than other options. The home has a kitchen and it’s very clean. The host is always available to help via text message. Have a nice trip y’all!

The listing is accurate. The A/C is in the living room but you can turn it on to keep the bedroom cool. Great amenities in the kitchen and facilities to do laundry. In other words, it has everything to keep your comfortable. The street is surrounded by local shops that sell food, dessert and there are many convenience stores around. I would stay here again in future stays. Thanks to the host and the staff that make the stay comfortable.
